items.front: You may think those shoes are in fashion, but they aren't.
items.meaning: 你可能認為那些鞋子很時髦, 但是他們不是。

items.front: You don't need to worry about such a thing.
items.meaning: 你不必擔心這樣的事情。

items.front: You are old enough to know better than to act like that.
items.meaning: 你夠大了知道不要那樣做。

items.front: You will wish you had never seen it.
items.meaning: 你會希望你從來沒有看過它。

items.front: Did you buy it on the black market?
items.meaning: 你是在黑市上买的它吗？

items.front: You should have done it earlier. It cannot be helped now.
items.meaning: 你應該早點做的。現在沒人可以幫你。

items.front: You will not be able to catch the train.
items.meaning: 你將無法趕上火車。

items.front: You should have introduced yourself to the girl.
items.meaning: 你應該向那個女孩自我介紹的。

items.front: You must return the book to him.
items.meaning: 这本书你该还给他。

items.front: You ought to know better at your age.
items.meaning: 在你這個年紀你應該要更懂事。

items.front: You owe me an apology for that.
items.meaning: 关于那件事你欠我一个道歉。

items.front: Are you for or against the plan?
items.meaning: 你赞成还是反对这个计划？

items.front: Are you planning to take part in the meeting?
items.meaning: 你们准备参加会议吗？

items.front: Do you deny that you went there?
items.meaning: 你否認你去了那裡嗎?

items.front: You should have told me a long time ago.
items.meaning: 很久以前你就應該告訴我的。

items.front: You'd better have your hair cut at once.
items.meaning: 你最好立刻剪頭髮。

items.front: You will soon get accustomed to living here.
items.meaning: 你很快就會習慣住在這裡。

items.front: You will soon be convinced I am right.
items.meaning: 你很快就會相信我是對的了。

items.front: You will soon get accustomed to your new school.
items.meaning: 你很快就会适应你的新学校。

items.front: You'd better go to see your family doctor at once.
items.meaning: 你最好立刻去看你的家庭醫生。

items.front: You may have mistaken Jane for his sister.
items.meaning: 你可能誤認珍為他的妹妹。

items.front: You must put an end to this foolish behavior.
items.meaning: 你该结束这种愚蠢的行为了。

items.front: Did you do this on your own?
items.meaning: 這是你自己做的嗎?

items.front: You have to put up with all these noises.
items.meaning: 你必须把无视这些声音。

items.front: You are not to leave this room.
items.meaning: 你不應該離開這個房間。

items.front: You have to put up with all this noise.
items.meaning: 你必须忍受这一切的噪音了。

items.front: You must get this homework finished by the day after tomorrow.
items.meaning: 你必須在後天以前完成回家作業。

items.front: You'll soon get accustomed to this cold weather.
items.meaning: 你很快就會習慣這種冷天氣。

items.front: How did you come by this money?
items.meaning: 用這些錢你怎麼來的?

items.front: All you have to do is sign your name here.
items.meaning: 你在這裏簽個名就行了。

items.front: You had better get away from here at once.
items.meaning: 你最好立刻離開這裡。

items.front: You have to study hard to catch up with your class.
items.meaning: 你必須用功讀書趕上同學。

items.front: Not only you but also I was involved.
items.meaning: 不止你， 连我也被牵连了。

items.front: You should ask your father for his advice and follow it.
items.meaning: 你應該問你父親的忠告並遵守它。

items.front: You should apologize to Dad for not coming home in time for supper.
items.meaning: 你應該為你沒有及時回家吃晚餐向你父親道歉。

items.front: You don't get up as early as your sister.
items.meaning: 你没有你姐姐起得那么早。

items.front: You are always as busy as a bee.
items.meaning: 你總是跟蜜蜂一樣地忙碌。

items.front: What time do you usually get up?
items.meaning: 你通常幾點起床？

items.front: What time do you usually go to bed?
items.meaning: 你通常甚麼時候上床睡覺？

items.front: What on earth are you talking about?
items.meaning: 你到底在談什麼?

items.front: How long have you been alienated from your family?
items.meaning: 你离开家有多久了?

items.front: You must be tired after such a long trip.
items.meaning: 在這麼長程的旅途後你一定很累了。

items.front: You shouldn't talk back to your parents like that.
items.meaning: 你不應該對你父母那樣頂嘴。

items.front: You shouldn't have eaten so much ice cream.
items.meaning: 你不應該吃這麼多冰淇淋。

items.front: I wish you had told me the truth then.
items.meaning: 但願你那時候就告訴我真相。

items.front: Do you know how high the television tower is?
items.meaning: 你知道那座電視塔有多高嗎？

items.front: You have to leave home at six.
items.meaning: 你必須在六點鐘時從家中出發。

items.front: You must be at the station by 5 o'clock.
items.meaning: 五點以前你必須在車站。

items.front: You look the way your father did thirty years ago.
items.meaning: 你看上去就像是三十年前你父親的樣子。

items.front: You must keep quiet for a few days.
items.meaning: 你该安静几天。

items.front: You'll be able to drive a car in a few days.
items.meaning: 幾天之後你就可以開車了。

items.front: Are you doing what you think is right?
items.meaning: 你在做你覺得對的事嗎?

items.front: You made the mistake on purpose, didn't you?
items.meaning: 你故意犯這個錯, 是嗎?

items.front: You only started this job an hour ago.
items.meaning: 你仅仅是一个小时前才开始这份工作的。

items.front: You may as well tell me all about it.
items.meaning: 你不妨告訴我一切。

items.front: You must always keep your hands clean.
items.meaning: 你应该一直让手保持干净。

items.front: In the light of what you told us, I think we should revise our plan.
items.meaning: 根据你所说的话，我认为我们应该重新审视我们的计划。

items.front: Is there anything you want that you don't have?
items.meaning: 有什么你想要但是没有的东西吗？

items.front: It won't be long before your dream comes true.
items.meaning: 你的夢想很快就會成真了。

items.front: Tell me about your program for the future.
items.meaning: 给我谈谈你未来的计划。

items.front: I am in favor of your proposal.
items.meaning: 我贊成你的建議。

items.front: If it had not been for your advice, I would have failed.
items.meaning: 如果沒有你的忠告，我大概已經失敗了吧。

items.front: I will give you a bicycle for your birthday.
items.meaning: 我在你的生日会送给你一辆自行车。

items.front: Your son took part in the student movement, I hear.
items.meaning: 聽說你兒子參與了學生運動。

items.front: I can hear you, but I can't see you.
items.meaning: 我听得见你，但我看不见你。

items.front: You have no one but yourself to blame.
items.meaning: 你只能怪責自己。

items.front: Your behavior is creating a lot of problems.
items.meaning: 你的行為引起了許多的麻煩。

items.front: Would you mind lending me your car?
items.meaning: 你介意把你的車借給我嗎?

items.front: Compared with yours, my car is small.
items.meaning: 和你的车比起来，我的车很小。

items.front: Look up the words in your dictionary.
items.meaning: 用你的詞典查查這些生字吧。

items.front: Could you lend me your bicycle for a couple of days?
items.meaning: 你能把你的自行车借我两天吗？

items.front: Your watch is more expensive than mine.
items.meaning: 你的手表比我的贵。

items.front: What time is it by your watch?
items.meaning: 你表上是几点？

items.front: I think your work is all right.
items.meaning: 我觉得你的工作可以。

items.front: Your composition was good except for the spelling.
items.meaning: 你的文章寫得很好，但卻有很多字拼錯了。

items.front: Your composition is very good, and it has few mistakes.
items.meaning: 你的作文非常好，而且错误很少。

items.front: There are few mistakes in your composition.
items.meaning: 你的文章裡有些錯誤。

items.front: Do you eat rice in your country?
items.meaning: 在你们国家吃米饭吗？

items.front: Your behavior leaves much to be desired.
items.meaning: 你的行为离要求的太远了。

items.front: What you are saying does not make sense.
items.meaning: 你说的没有意义。

items.front: Your words must correspond with your actions.
items.meaning: 你的言行必须一致。

items.front: What you say is quite wide of the mark.
items.meaning: 您说的话完全跑题了。

items.front: All that you say is perfectly correct.
items.meaning: 你說得完全正確。

items.front: You can go or stay, as you wish.
items.meaning: 你走或留，随你高兴。

items.front: Your shoes do not go with the suit.
items.meaning: 你的鞋子和衣服不合襯。

items.front: I think your basic theory is wrong.
items.meaning: 我認為你的基本理論是錯的。

items.front: How many pupils are there in your school?
items.meaning: 你的學校有多少個學生？

items.front: Let's discuss your love problems on the way back from school.
items.meaning: 從學校回來的路上讓我們來討論你的愛情問題。

items.front: I'm amazed at your fluency in English.
items.meaning: 你流利的英语让我很吃惊。

items.front: I agree with some of your opinions.
items.meaning: 我同意你一部分的意见。

items.front: I'll give you anything that you want.
items.meaning: 我會給你任何你想要的東西。

items.front: I am ready to do anything for you.
items.meaning: 我甘心为你做任何事。

items.front: How many are there in your class?
items.meaning: 你班裏有多少人？

items.front: Your camera is only half the size of mine.
items.meaning: 你的照相機只有我那台的一半大小。

items.front: You'll get into trouble if your girlfriend finds out the truth.
items.meaning: 如果你女朋友发现真相的话，你会有麻烦的。

items.front: Your mother must have been beautiful when she was young.
items.meaning: 你母親年輕的時候一定很美。

items.front: I have no idea what you mean.
items.meaning: 我不明白你想說甚麼。

items.front: I have some good news for you.
items.meaning: 我有好消息要告訴你。

items.front: I will find you a good doctor.
items.meaning: 我會幫你找個好醫生。

items.front: I want you to read this book.
items.meaning: 我想你讀一讀這本書。

items.front: I refuse to be treated like a slave by you.
items.meaning: 我拒绝被你像奴隶一样对待。

items.front: Your telegram arrived just as I was about to telephone you.
items.meaning: 我正想打電話給你，你的電報就送來了。

items.front: Who is that girl waving to you?
items.meaning: 那個向你招手的女孩是誰？

items.front: I'll teach you how to drive a car.
items.meaning: 我会教你怎么开车。

items.front: I wanted to show it to you.
items.meaning: 我想把它給你看。

items.front: I am looking forward to seeing you.
items.meaning: 我期待見到你。

items.front: All you can do is to wait.
items.meaning: 所有你能做的就是等待。

items.front: You and I are the same age.
items.meaning: 你和我同龄。

items.front: If only I could speak English as fluently as you!
items.meaning: 如果我說英語能說得跟你一樣流利的話就好了!

items.front: I'd like to go with you, but as it is I can't.
items.meaning: 我很想跟你一起去, 但重點是我不能去。

items.front: I wish I could go to the party with you.
items.meaning: 我希望我能和你一起参加派对。

items.front: I would like to go to the concert with you.
items.meaning: 我想和你一起去音乐会。

items.front: I would prefer to speak to you in private.
items.meaning: 我想和你單獨談談。

items.front: How old will you be next year?
items.meaning: 明年你会是几岁？

items.front: You had better not start until they arrive.
items.meaning: 你最好不要在他們來之前開始。

items.front: You should try to be more polite.
items.meaning: 你應該試著更有禮貌。

items.front: It is imperative for you to act at once.
items.meaning: 你必须马上行动。

items.front: Compare your sentence with the one on the blackboard.
items.meaning: 比較一下你寫的句子和黑板上的句子。

items.front: Not only are you wrong, but I am wrong too.
items.meaning: 錯的不只是你，我自己也錯了。

items.front: You are the man I've been looking for.
items.meaning: 你就是我一直要找的人。

items.front: You're the best man for the job.
items.meaning: 你是做這份工作最好的人選。

items.front: I hadn't recognized the importance of this document until you told me about it.
items.meaning: 你告訴了我以後，我才知道這份文件有多重要。

items.front: It's a pity that you can't come.
items.meaning: 很遗憾你们不能来。

items.front: As long as you are here, we might as well begin.
items.meaning: 既然你在這裡, 那我們就開始吧。

items.front: That you don't believe me is a great pity.
items.meaning: 很遺憾你不相信我。

items.front: The information you gave me is of little use.
items.meaning: 你給我的資料沒有多大的用處。

items.front: I don't know whether you like her or not.
items.meaning: 我不知道你喜不喜歡她。

items.front: Does he know that you love him?
items.meaning: 他知道你愛他嗎?

items.front: It was foolish of you to accept his offer.
items.meaning: 你真笨去接受他的提議。

items.front: Whatever you said to him made him feel better.
items.meaning: 你對他說的話讓他感覺好多了。

items.front: I cannot approve of your going out with him.
items.meaning: 我不能讓你和他出去。

items.front: I saw you with a tall boy.
items.meaning: 我看見你和一個個子高的男孩在一起。

items.front: He is no more foolish than you are.
items.meaning: 你们俩都不傻。

items.front: It's a pity that you should leave Japan.
items.meaning: 你要离开日本真是个遗憾。

items.front: I am going to do it whether you agree or not.
items.meaning: 不管你同意还是不同意，我还是要做。

items.front: I don't object to your going out to work, but who will look after the children?
items.meaning: 我并不反对你出去工作，可是小孩靠谁来照看呢？

items.front: You have good reason to be angry.
items.meaning: 你有充分的理由生氣。

items.front: We were just talking about you when you called.
items.meaning: 當你打電話來時, 我們正在談論你。

items.front: Whether you will succeed or not depends on your efforts.
items.meaning: 爱拼才会赢。

items.front: I am glad that you have succeeded.
items.meaning: 我很高兴你们成功了。

items.front: Who took care of the dog while you were away?
items.meaning: 你不在的時候誰照看狗？

items.front: The reason why you failed is you did not try hard enough.
items.meaning: 因為你不夠努力，所以才會失敗。

items.front: You should talk to the teacher yourself.
items.meaning: 你應該自己跟老師說。

items.front: I love you more than you love me.
items.meaning: 我爱你胜过你爱我。

items.front: I wish you could come with us.
items.meaning: 但願你可以跟我們一起來。

items.front: With your approval, I would like to offer him the job.
items.meaning: 如果您同意, 我想給他這份工作。

items.front: Nothing is so tasty as the dish you make.
items.meaning: 沒有甚麼比你做的菜更好吃了。

items.front: Choose the color you like the best.
items.meaning: 選你最喜歡的顏色。

items.front: You don't need to go unless you want to.
items.meaning: 你不想去的話不必去。

items.front: If you don't go, I won't, either.
items.meaning: 如果你不去，那我也不會去。

items.front: You can't be hungry. You've just had dinner.
items.meaning: 你剛剛才吃過晚飯，不可能餓得這麼快的。

items.front: Be sure to put out the fire before you leave.
items.meaning: 一定要熄了火，然后再离开。

items.front: I'll stay here till you get back.
items.meaning: 我會待在這裡直到你回來。

items.front: I was about to leave when you telephoned.
items.meaning: 你打來的時候我正準備出門。

items.front: I'm looking forward to hearing from you.
items.meaning: 我期待收到您的來信。

items.front: You can do whatever you want to.
items.meaning: 你可以做任何你想做的事。

items.front: Try to estimate how much you spent on books.
items.meaning: 算一算你花了多少錢買書。

items.front: How can I feel relaxed, with you watching me like that?
items.meaning: 你那么看着我，我哪里放松得下来啊？

items.front: It's absurd of you to do that.
items.meaning: 你那么做真是太过荒谬了.

items.front: It is absurd of you to do that.
items.meaning: 你那么做真是太过荒谬了.

items.front: It makes little difference to me whether you believe it or not.
items.meaning: 你相信也好，不相信也好，對我來說沒有甚麼分別。

items.front: The time will come when you will be sorry for it.
items.meaning: 你一定會後悔的。

items.front: I don't blame you for doing that.
items.meaning: 我不怪你那樣做。

items.front: We will pay you according to the amount of work you do.
items.meaning: 我們會按照你的工作量付錢給你。

items.front: It's a pity that you couldn't come.
items.meaning: 很遺憾你不能來。

items.front: It is out of the question for you to go to New York this weekend.
items.meaning: 這個週末去紐約對你來說是不可能的事。

items.front: As long as you're here, I'll stay.
items.meaning: 只要你在這兒，我就會留下來。

items.front: My life would be completely empty without you.
items.meaning: 如果沒有你，我的人生就會變得空白一片。

items.front: We shall all miss you when you go away.
items.meaning: 你走了，我们都会想你的。

items.front: You may stay here as long as you like.
items.meaning: 你想在这儿待多久就待多久。

items.front: Have you ever seen Mt. Fuji? It is beautiful beyond description.
items.meaning: 你看過富士山嗎? 它美得無法形容。

items.front: There is a hole in your sock.
items.meaning: 你的袜子上有个洞。

items.front: These shoes are too tight. They hurt.
items.meaning: 这些鞋子太紧了，伤脚。

items.front: Even times odd is even, odd times odd is odd.
items.meaning: 偶数乘以奇数是偶数，奇数乘以奇数是奇数。

items.front: Judging from the look of the sky, it may rain this afternoon.
items.meaning: 從天色上判斷，今天下午可能會下雨。

items.front: He cannot be hungry; he has just had lunch.
items.meaning: 他剛剛才吃完午飯，不可能會肚子餓。

items.front: Our house was robbed while we were away.
items.meaning: 我们走开的时候，房子被盗窃了。

items.front: Fill in the blanks with suitable words.
items.meaning: 請在空格上填上適當的字詞。

items.front: How far is it to the airport?
items.meaning: 到机场有多远？

items.front: Please tell me how to get to the airport.
items.meaning: 請你告訴我機場怎麼去。

items.front: I went to the airport by taxi.
items.meaning: 我搭計程車去的機場。

items.front: Where do I get an airport bus?
items.meaning: 我能在哪里乘上机场巴士？

items.front: How long does the airport bus take to the airport?
items.meaning: 乘机场大巴去机场要多久？

items.front: I'll phone you as soon as I get to the airport.
items.meaning: 我一到了機場就打電話給你。

items.front: I have to go to the airport to meet my family.
items.meaning: 我要去機場迎接我的家人。

items.front: Please pick me up at the airport at five.
items.meaning: 請於五點鐘到機場接我。

items.front: We saw her off at the airport.
items.meaning: 我们在机场为她送行。

items.front: How far is it from the airport to the hotel?
items.meaning: 從機場到旅館多遠？

items.front: Tiny particles in the air can cause cancer.
items.meaning: 空气中的微粒可以引发癌症。

items.front: Air is a mixture of various gases.
items.meaning: 空氣是由許多種氣體組成的混合物。

items.front: Air quality has deteriorated these past few years.
items.meaning: 这些年空气质量恶化了。

items.front: Both air and water are indispensable for life.
items.meaning: 沒有空氣和水，人類就無法生存。

items.front: Without air there can be no wind or sound on the moon.
items.meaning: 月球表面沒有空氣，所以沒有風，也沒有聲音。

items.front: The sky is clear almost every day.
items.meaning: 天空幾乎每天是晴朗的。

items.front: The clouds floating in the sky are beautiful.
items.meaning: 天空飘的云很美。

items.front: Not a single cloud could be seen in the sky.
items.meaning: 天上萬里無雲。

items.front: There is a mass of dark clouds in the sky.
items.meaning: 空中有一大片乌云。

items.front: You can see a lot of stars in the sky.
items.meaning: 你能看到天空中的繁星。

items.front: Seen from the sky, the river looked like a huge snake.
items.meaning: 从天上看下来，这条河像一条巨蛇。

items.front: A fool and his money are soon parted.
items.meaning: 笨蛋難聚財。

items.front: You've acted foolishly and you will pay for it.
items.meaning: 你愚蠢地行事，你会付出代价。

items.front: Take this medicine in case you get sick.
items.meaning: 万一你生病了，吃这个药。

items.front: Bank robbery will cost you ten years in prison.
items.meaning: 搶劫銀行的後果就是在監獄裏蹲十年。

items.front: Banks charge higher interest on loans to risky customers.
items.meaning: 银行对风险客户收取较高的贷款利息。

items.front: I ran across an old friend near the bank.
items.meaning: 我在银行附近碰见老朋友。

items.front: Some people do not like to deposit their money in banks.
items.meaning: 有些人不喜欢把钱存银行。

items.front: I made a deposit of $1,000 at the bank.
items.meaning: 我在银行存了1000美金。

items.front: Do you have any idea when the bank closes?
items.meaning: 你知道银行什么时候关门吗？

items.front: I need to know your answer by Friday.
items.meaning: 我需要星期五之前知道你的答案。

items.front: Every Friday night they went and got liquored up.
items.meaning: 他們星期五每晚都去喝酒。

items.front: Money is the root of all evil.
items.meaning: 金錢是一切罪惡之源。

items.front: The rich are apt to look down upon the poor.
items.meaning: 富人往往瞧不起穷人。

items.front: I prefer being poor to being rich.
items.meaning: 我更愿意贫穷而不是富裕。

items.front: The papers that were in the safe are gone.
items.meaning: 放在保險箱裏面的文件不見了。

items.front: Lend me some money if you have any.
items.meaning: 你有钱的话，借我一些。

items.front: No money, no job, no friends. He was truly at loose ends.
items.meaning: 没钱，没工作，没朋友，他真是无所适从。

items.front: I will give you the money tomorrow.
items.meaning: 我明天會給你錢。

items.front: The money was hidden beneath the floorboards.
items.meaning: 那些錢藏了在地板下面。

items.front: Gold is similar in color to brass.
items.meaning: 金的顏色和黃銅很相似。

items.front: Keep the money in a safe place.
items.meaning: 把錢保存在安全的地方。

items.front: I have no money, but I have dreams.
items.meaning: 我沒有錢，但是我有夢想。

items.front: The price of gold varies from day to day.
items.meaning: 金價每天都在變動。

items.front: Money is the last thing he wants.
items.meaning: 钱是他想要的最后的东西。

items.front: Many local traditions have fallen into decay in recent years.
items.meaning: 近几年，很多当地的传统都衰败了。

items.front: Modern travel enables us to go around the world in a few days.
items.meaning: 现代交通使我们能在几天内环绕地球。

items.front: The art of modern warfare does not necessarily require soldiers to be armed to the teeth to be effective as combatants.
items.meaning: 現代戰術並無指明士兵必須全副武裝上陣才能發揮其最大的戰鬥力。

items.front: The whole neighborhood was surprised at the news.
items.meaning: 整个小区对这个消息很惊讶。

items.front: The recent frequency of earthquakes makes us nervous.
items.meaning: 最近频繁的地震让我们很焦虑。

items.front: How are you getting along these days?
items.meaning: 你最近怎樣？

items.front: I have not heard from her recently.
items.meaning: 我最近沒有收到她的信。

items.front: Although her house is nearby, I seldom see her.
items.meaning: 雖然我住在她家附近，可是也很少見到她。

items.front: Are there any movie theaters near here?
items.meaning: 這裏附近有沒有電影院？

items.front: In the near future, we may have a big earthquake in Japan.
items.meaning: 在不久的将来，可能有一场大地震将在日本发生。

items.front: These problems will be solved in the near future.
items.meaning: 在不久的將來這些問題都會迎刃而解。

items.front: I'll get in touch with you soon.
items.meaning: 我會很快跟你聯絡。

items.front: I am looking forward to hearing from you soon.
items.meaning: 我期待很快就能收到你的信。

items.front: I'll come and see you one of these days.
items.meaning: 这些天我会抽一天来看你的。

items.front: In case of an emergency, get in touch with my agent.
items.meaning: 万一有紧急情况，联系我的代理人。

items.front: In case of emergency, call the police.
items.meaning: 在緊急情況下，打電話報警。

items.front: In case of an emergency, get in touch with my agent right away.
items.meaning: 如遇情况紧急，请立即联系我的代理。

items.front: It is difficult to give up smoking.
items.meaning: 戒煙很難。

items.front: The workers complained when their working hours were extended.
items.meaning: 当工作时间被延长时，工人们忍不住开口抱怨起来。

items.front: She became rich by virtue of hard work and good business sense.
items.meaning: 她憑著努力和生意頭腦成了富翁。

items.front: Slight inattention can cause a great disaster.
items.meaning: 失之毫厘，谬之千里。

items.front: He does not, in short, write with the candor of a man who is completely confident of his thesis.
items.meaning: 簡單來說，他的文筆並沒有流露出那種對自己的論文充滿信心的人應有的直率和坦誠。

items.front: I'm glad we didn't go there because there were some localized heavy rain showers.
items.meaning: 我很庆幸我们没有去那儿，因为当时那儿有局部大暴雨。

items.front: The vase on my desk overturned when I jumped up in surprise.
items.meaning: 我突然跳起来的时候把花瓶桌子上的打翻了。

items.front: To my surprise, there were no people in the village.
items.meaning: 奇怪的是，村子裏竟然一個人也沒有。

items.front: To my surprise, the door was unlocked.
items.meaning: 令我驚訝的是，門沒上鎖。

items.front: To my surprise, he easily came up with a plan.
items.meaning: 令我吃惊的是，他很容易就想出了一个方案。

items.front: To my surprise, he had a beautiful voice.
items.meaning: 他的歌聲出乎意料之外地好聽。

items.front: In nostalgic moments we may tend to think of childhood as a time of almost unbroken happiness.
items.meaning: 在懷念舊日時光的時刻，我們可能往往想起童年像是有著幾乎完整幸福的一段時期。

items.front: He is not just interested, he's crazy about it.
items.meaning: 他不仅是对这个有兴趣，并相当热衷。

items.front: I was so excited that I could not fall asleep.
items.meaning: 我興奮得睡不著覺。

items.front: There is a cottage beyond the bridge.
items.meaning: 桥对面有一间小屋。

items.front: In culture, they are on the same plane as savages.
items.meaning: 在教養上，他們可以說是和野蠻人差不多。

items.front: My driving instructor says I should be more patient.
items.meaning: 我的駕駛導師說我應該耐心一點。

items.front: The professor scolded John for skipping class.
items.meaning: 教授罵了約翰一頓因為他翹了幾堂課。

items.front: Take off your hat when you enter a classroom.
items.meaning: 进教室时请脱下帽子。

items.front: There were few students remaining in the classroom.
items.meaning: 教室里没剩下几个学生了。

items.front: Do you eat it in the classroom?
items.meaning: 您在教室裡吃它嗎？

items.front: Teachers should treat all their students impartially.
items.meaning: 老师应该一视同仁地对待他们的学生。

items.front: I have been a teacher for 15 years.
items.meaning: 我當老師已經15年了。

items.front: What is the ultimate purpose of education?
items.meaning: 教育的最终目的到底是什么?

items.front: One of the great superstitions about education is that learning is the result of teaching.
items.meaning: 很多人覺得有教才有學，但其實這個觀念是錯的。

items.front: More money for education will spur economic growth.
items.meaning: 更多投資在教育的錢將會刺激經濟成長。

items.front: Sorry, but can you show me the way to the next village?
items.meaning: 能不能麻烦你告诉我去邻村怎么走？

items.front: I'm afraid you have to work overtime.
items.meaning: 恐怕你要加班了。

items.front: The victim of blackmail has been paying hush money for years, but now he realizes it is foolish, and has decided not to pay a red cent more.
items.meaning: 被害人被勒索支付封口費已經很多年, 但現在他意識到這樣做是愚蠢的, 而且他已經決定再也不付一毛錢了。

items.front: The strong wind indicates that a storm is coming.
items.meaning: 強風暗示著即將到來的暴雨。

items.front: The thieves knocked off another bank today in a daytime robbery.
items.meaning: 今天强盗大白天的就抢了另一家银行。

items.front: The burglar was traced by one of the things he had left on the scene.
items.meaning: 警方根據現場遺下的證物把賊子找了出來。

items.front: The burglar shut the child in the closet.
items.meaning: 強盗把小孩關在了衣櫃裏。

items.front: Communism is the system practiced in the Soviet Union.
items.meaning: 共產主義是在蘇聯被實行的制度。

items.front: Kyoto is not as large as Osaka.
items.meaning: 京都不如大阪大。

items.front: Kyoto is famous for its shrines and temples.
items.meaning: 京都以它的祭坛和寺院而闻名。

items.front: Kyoto is famous for its old temples.
items.meaning: 京都以古廟有名。

items.front: My hobbies are fishing and watching television.
items.meaning: 我的興趣是釣魚和看電視。

items.front: Eating fish is good for your health.
items.meaning: 吃鱼有益于你的健康。

items.front: I'll show you how to catch fish.
items.meaning: 我会向你展示怎样捕鱼。

items.front: I got a fish bone stuck in my throat.
items.meaning: 我被鱼骨刺到了喉咙。

items.front: Air is to us what water is to fish.
items.meaning: 空气对人来说就是水对鱼的意义。

items.front: Fish have stopped living in this river.
items.meaning: 這條河裏已經沒有魚了。

items.front: Those present were all moved to tears.
items.meaning: 在座的人全都被感動得流下了淚來。

items.front: The living room adjoins the dining room.
items.meaning: 客廳緊鄰著餐廳。

items.front: I took an art class last year.
items.meaning: 我去年上了一堂藝術課。

items.front: We had a lot of snow last year.
items.meaning: 去年下了很多雪。

items.front: We had a mild winter last year.
items.meaning: 去年冬天很暖和。

items.front: There was a lot of snow last winter.
items.meaning: 去年冬天下了好多雪。

items.front: We moved to New York last fall.
items.meaning: 我們去年秋天搬到了紐約。

items.front: I'll never forget visiting Paris last summer.
items.meaning: 我永遠不會忘記去年夏天到訪巴黎的經歷。

items.front: The village which I visited last summer was a small one in Nagano Prefecture.
items.meaning: 我去年夏天到訪的是一個位於長野縣的小村落。

items.front: We had a kid just last year.
items.meaning: 就在去年我們有了一個孩子。

items.front: Out of sight out of mind. When you're separated you lose touch.
items.meaning: 久了不見，便會逐漸淡忘。分開以後，也就自然不會再聯絡了。

items.front: We make milk into cheese and butter.
items.meaning: 我們把牛奶製成乳酪和奶油。

items.front: The cows were moving very slowly through the long green grass.
items.meaning: 牛群在鬱鬱蔥蔥的草地上緩緩移動著。

items.front: Cows are eating grass in the meadow.
items.meaning: 牛在牧地上吃草。

items.front: As soon as I get paid I will pay you back.
items.meaning: 我一收到錢就馬上還錢給你。

items.front: A cornered rat will bite a cat.
items.meaning: 窮鼠囓狸。

items.front: I don't know whether to cry or to laugh.
items.meaning: 我真是哭笑不得了。

items.front: The rescue workers are going to hand out supplies to the victims of the earthquake.
items.meaning: 救助人员将为地震受灾者发放物资。

items.front: We waited for hours before help arrived.
items.meaning: 一直等了好幾個小時，才有人來救我們。

items.front: The ambulances carried the injured to the nearest hospital.
items.meaning: 救护车把伤者送往了最近的医院。

items.front: All of a sudden the sky became overcast.
items.meaning: 天突然转阴了。

items.front: All of a sudden, large drops of rain began falling from the dark sky.
items.meaning: 灰暗的天空突然下起了一大滴一大滴的雨來。

items.front: All of a sudden, three dogs appeared in front of us.
items.meaning: 突然之間，三隻狗出現在我們面前。

items.front: If you hurry, you'll catch up with him.
items.meaning: 你動作快點就能趕上他。

items.front: Hurry, and you will catch the train.
items.meaning: 快一点，你就能赶上火车了。

items.front: Hurry up, or you will miss the train.
items.meaning: 快点，不然你就要错过火车了。

items.front: Hurry up, or you will be late.
items.meaning: 快一点，否则你会迟到。

items.front: Hurry up, or you'll miss the bus.
items.meaning: 快點，否則你會錯過公車。

items.front: Hurry up, and you will be in time for the bus.
items.meaning: 快点，你就能准时搭上公交车了。

items.front: If you don't hurry, you'll miss the train.
items.meaning: 如果你不抓紧的话，你就会赶不上火车。

items.front: There's enough time for a quick snack.
items.meaning: 有足夠的時間很快地吃一下點心。

items.front: Having been written in haste, the book has a lot of errors.
items.meaning: 這本書是匆匆忙忙地寫的，所以有很多謬誤。

items.front: Miyazaki is not what it used to be.
items.meaning: 宮崎不是它往日的樣子了。

items.front: What did you do on your vacation?
items.meaning: 你们放假的时候做了什么？

items.front: I spent idle days during the vacation.
items.meaning: 假期里，我度过了悠闲的日子。

items.front: Where do you suppose you'll spend your vacation?
items.meaning: 你认为你会到哪儿度假？

items.front: The vacation is close to an end.
items.meaning: 假期快要结束了。

items.front: Have you made up your mind where to go for the holidays?
items.meaning: 你想好放假去哪裏玩了沒有？

items.front: When I go on vacation, I'll rent a car.
items.meaning: 去度假的时候我要租辆车。

items.front: Where are you going to go on your vacation?
items.meaning: 你放假打算去甚麼地方玩呢？

items.front: After running up the hill, I was completely out of breath.
items.meaning: 跑上山後，我完全喘不過氣來。

items.front: The building on the hill is our school.
items.meaning: 山上的那棟建築物就是我們的學校了。

items.front: The old church on the hill dates back to the twelfth century.
items.meaning: 山上的老教堂的歷史可以追溯到12世紀。

items.front: There is a house on the hill.
items.meaning: 山上有個房子。

items.front: A beautiful valley lies behind the hill.
items.meaning: 小山后面有个美丽的山谷。

items.front: We came in sight of the hill.
items.meaning: 我们看见了小山。

items.front: As I entered the café, I found two young men watching a wrestling match on television.
items.meaning: 我步進咖啡室，看見兩個年輕人正在電視上看摔角比賽。

items.front: Smokers are far more likely to develop lung cancer than non-smokers are.
items.meaning: 吸煙的人患上肺癌的風險比不吸煙的人高得多。

items.front: Smokers take twice as many days off sick as non-smokers.
items.meaning: 吸煙的人請病假的日數比不吸煙的人多兩倍。

items.front: I wish I could break the habit of smoking.
items.meaning: 真希望自己能把烟瘾戒掉。

items.front: Most people killed by smoking were not heavy smokers.
items.meaning: 大多數被香煙害死的人吸的煙都不多。

items.front: Smoking or health, the choice is yours.
items.meaning: 吸烟还是健康，选择权在你。

items.front: After they argued, they didn't speak to each other for a week.
items.meaning: 他们争吵后，一周都没有再说话。

items.front: Let's proceed with the items on the agenda.
items.meaning: 讓我們繼續進行議程上的項目。

items.front: You are not to neglect your duty.
items.meaning: 你不能漠視你的責任。

items.front: What is the difference between imitation and real diamonds?
items.meaning: 假的鑽石和真的鑽石有甚麼分別？

items.front: When the cat is away, the mice will play.
items.meaning: 貓兒不在，老鼠玩的輕鬆自在。

items.front: I'll always love you, no matter what happens.
items.meaning: 不論發生了什麼事，我會永遠愛你。

items.front: You should keep your valuables in a safe place.
items.meaning: 你该把你的值钱物品保存在一个安全的地方。

items.front: It is still fresh in my memory.
items.meaning: 我仍然記憶猶新。

items.front: Regular exercise is beneficial to good health.
items.meaning: 多運動有益健康。

items.front: We punished him according to the rules.
items.meaning: 我们按例处罚了他。

items.front: By the year 2020, the population of our city will have doubled.
items.meaning: 在2020年以前，我們的城市的人口將增加一倍。

items.front: A whistle blew, and the boat slowly began to pull out of port.
items.meaning: 汽笛声响起，船开始慢慢地驶离港口。

items.front: Which goes faster, a ship or a train?
items.meaning: 船和火车哪个跑得快？

items.front: The train was delayed because of heavy snowfall.
items.meaning: 火车因大雪被耽搁了。

items.front: The train will arrive on time without fail.
items.meaning: 我保證火車會準時來。

items.front: The train was delayed, so I could not arrive there on time.
items.meaning: 火车晚点了，所以我不能准时赶到那里。

items.front: They waved good-bye to their parents as the train pulled out.
items.meaning: 火車開出的時候，他們都揮手向父母道別。

items.front: It was a pleasant day, but there were few people in the park.
items.meaning: 那天天氣很好，但公園裏人並不多。

items.front: Do you think our climate has an influence on our character?
items.meaning: 你覺得氣候會不會影響人的性格呢？

items.front: The temperature has been below freezing for several days.
items.meaning: 零度以下的氣溫持續了好幾天。

items.front: My joints ache when it gets cold.
items.meaning: 當天氣變冷的時候，我的關節疼痛。

items.front: The barometer is falling. It is going to rain.
items.meaning: 气压计下降了 - 要下雨了。

items.front: Look out! There's a hole in the road.
items.meaning: 小心。路上有一個洞。

items.front: Watch out! There's a big hole there.
items.meaning: 小心！在那裡有一個大洞。

items.front: The pitiful sight moved us to tears.
items.meaning: 看著眼前淒涼的景象，我們不禁流下了淚來。

items.front: Turn off the television. I can't concentrate.
items.meaning: 把電視關掉。我無法專心。

items.front: I met him on my way home.
items.meaning: 我在回家的路上遇到了他。

items.front: I'm very sorry I came home so late.
items.meaning: 我很抱歉那么晚回家。

items.front: I caught sight of a parade on my way home.
items.meaning: 在回家的路上，我看到一场阅兵式。

items.front: Would you mind picking up something on the way back?
items.meaning: 你介不介意回来的路上带些东西？

items.front: Please drop in at my house on your way home.
items.meaning: 你回家途中順道來看看我吧。

items.front: It'd be great if you could pick up some bread before you come home.
items.meaning: 这将会是巨大的，如果你可以挑选一些面包，然后再回家。

items.front: I'll call by the post office on the way home.
items.meaning: 我回家時會順道去一去郵政局。

items.front: Passengers became nervous when the plane began to vibrate.
items.meaning: 飛機開始震動的時候，乘客們都緊張了起來。

items.front: I was busy studying for the term exam.
items.meaning: 我忙于应付期末考试。

items.front: I'm busy because the finals are drawing on.
items.meaning: 快要考期末試了，所以我很忙。

items.front: I see a book on the desk.
items.meaning: 我看到桌上有本书。

items.front: There is a book on the desk.
items.meaning: 桌上有一本書。

items.front: There is a map on the desk.
items.meaning: 办公桌上面有一张地图。

items.front: There are some books on the desk.
items.meaning: 书桌上有几本书。

items.front: I see a flower on the desk.
items.meaning: 我看见书桌上有朵花。

items.front: There is an apple on the desk.
items.meaning: 书桌上有一个苹果。

items.front: There is one apple on the desk.
items.meaning: 书桌上有一个苹果。

items.front: There is a bag on the desk.
items.meaning: 书桌上有一个包。

items.front: Look at that picture on the desk.
items.meaning: 看看桌上的那張相片。

items.front: There is a cat under the desk.
items.meaning: 书桌下有一只猫。

items.front: There is an apple under the desk.
items.meaning: 桌子下面有一顆蘋果。

items.front: Are there any books under the desk?
items.meaning: 写字台底下有没有任何书？

items.front: The importation of rare wild animals to this country is strictly prohibited.
items.meaning: 该国严禁进口稀有野生动物。

items.front: It may sound strange, but what she said is true.
items.meaning: 聽起來或許有點怪，但她說的是真的。

items.front: Strange to say, no one voted for the candidate.
items.meaning: 奇怪的是，誰也沒有投那候選人一票。

items.front: Strange to say, he didn't know the news.
items.meaning: 说来奇怪，他不知道这个消息。

items.front: In a crisis, you must get in touch with your teacher.
items.meaning: 在危險的時候你必須跟你的老師聯繫。

items.front: Corporate earnings in the first quarter improved sharply.
items.meaning: 企业第一季度收益大幅增长。

items.front: I hope my dream will come true.
items.meaning: 我希望我的梦想实现。

items.front: He told me to wash my face.
items.meaning: 他叫我洗脸。

items.front: The rocks are weathered into fantastic forms.
items.meaning: 岩石經過風化後，形成了各種奇特的形狀。

items.front: The cancer has spread to her stomach.
items.meaning: 癌細胞已經擴散到她的胃。

items.front: Can you hear the noise of the waves on the beach?
items.meaning: 你能聽到沙灘上海浪的聲音嗎？

items.front: Korean food is noted for its spicy flavor.
items.meaning: 韓國菜以辛辣聞名。

items.front: Don't laugh at him for making a mistake.
items.meaning: 不要笑他犯了错误。

items.front: Correct the errors if there are any.
items.meaning: 如有錯誤，請改正。

items.front: Correct the mistake and return the file to Mr Luxemburg.
items.meaning: 請把錯誤改正過來，然後把文件夾還給 Luxemburg 先生。

items.front: To err is human, to forgive divine.
items.meaning: 人皆有錯，唯聖者能恕。

items.front: It won't be long before they get married.
items.meaning: 他們很快就會結婚了。

items.front: We will soon be ready for the party.
items.meaning: 很快地我們的派對就要準備完成了。

items.front: Visiting all the tourist sights really wore me out.
items.meaning: 參觀所有觀光勝地累壞了我。

items.front: The tourists were fascinated with the exquisite scenery.
items.meaning: 觀光客被獨特的景致所吸引。

items.front: The number of tourists has increased greatly in recent years.
items.meaning: 近年的遊客數量大幅增加。

items.front: The sightseeing bus ran through a long tunnel.
items.meaning: 觀光巴士穿過了一條長長的隧道。

items.front: To put it briefly, I do not agree.
items.meaning: 简而言之，我不同意。

items.front: As it is written in simple English, this book is easy to read.
items.meaning: 由於是用簡單的英語所寫的，這本書很容易閱讀。

items.front: The nurse took his temperature with a thermometer.
items.meaning: 護士用溫度計量了量他的體溫。

items.front: Have you ever thought of becoming a nurse?
items.meaning: 你曾經想過當個護士嗎?

items.front: The nurse will tell you how to do it.
items.meaning: 护士会告诉你怎么做。

items.front: When it comes to sweets, I just can't control myself.
items.meaning: 一看到甜点，我就无法自拔。

items.front: Environmental pollution is causing abnormal weather conditions.
items.meaning: 環境污染正造成異常的天氣情況。

items.front: We ought to do our best not to pollute our environment.
items.meaning: 我們應該盡力不要污染環境。

items.front: Almost no students get full marks in Chinese classics.
items.meaning: 很少有学生能在古汉语考试上拿满分。

items.front: I don't know how to express my thanks.
items.meaning: 我不知道如何表達我的謝意。

items.front: The patient got better little by little.
items.meaning: 病人逐漸康復了。

items.front: I find it hard to get up early on cold mornings.
items.meaning: 我覺得在寒冷的早晨很難早起。

items.front: Stock prices plunged to a record low.
items.meaning: 股票價格跌至歷史新低。

items.front: The sum came to over 20,000 yen.
items.meaning: 总金额达到了两万日元。

items.front: The frame itself is worth more than the picture.
items.meaning: 画框比画还值钱。

items.front: The students stood waiting for a bus.
items.meaning: 学生们站着等巴士。

items.front: This is a store that caters specially to students.
items.meaning: 这是一家专门为学生提供服务的商店。

items.front: Students generally like a teacher who understands their problems.
items.meaning: 通常学生们喜欢理解他们问题的老师。

items.front: The students' lunch period is from twelve to one.
items.meaning: 學生的午飯時間是十二點到一點。

items.front: The students learned many poems by heart.
items.meaning: 学生们用心学习了很多首诗。

items.front: The students noted down every word the teacher said.
items.meaning: 學生們把老師說的話一字不漏地記了下來。

items.front: According to some scholars, a major earthquake could occur at any moment now.
items.meaning: 据一些学者称，现在可能随时发生一场特大地震。

items.front: I would often take part in an English speech contest in my school days.
items.meaning: 当年我在学校的时候经常参加英语演讲比赛。

items.front: Is your school far from your home?
items.meaning: 你的學校離你家很遠嗎?

items.front: The school is located within five minutes' walk of the station.
items.meaning: 學校坐落於距離車站步行五分鐘的地方。

items.front: School uniforms are just out of fashion.
items.meaning: 只是校服过时了。

items.front: I called at Nancy's house on my way home from school.
items.meaning: 在放学回家的路上，我拜访了Nancy家。

items.front: I'm going to join the school orchestra.
items.meaning: 我打算加入學校的管弦樂團。

items.front: You must not be late for school.
items.meaning: 你上學不可以遲到。

items.front: The number of students who were late for school was much smaller than I had expected.
items.meaning: 上學遲到的學生人數比我想像中少很多。

items.front: Instead of going to school, he stayed at home.
items.meaning: 他沒有上學，留在了家中。

items.front: I live within walking distance of school.
items.meaning: 我學校離我家只是幾步路的路程。

items.front: School has started and I like it so far.
items.meaning: 開學了，目前感覺還不錯。

items.front: I have just come back from school.
items.meaning: 我刚从学校回来。

items.front: When she saw that they had no schools, she started one.
items.meaning: 当她发现他们还没有学校，她就办了一个。

items.front: They helped one another to make the school festival a success.
items.meaning: 他们互帮互助，把校庆搞得很成功。

items.front: After the revolution, France became a republic.
items.meaning: 革命之後，法國成為了一個共和國。

items.front: The revolution has brought about many changes.
items.meaning: 这场革命已经带来了很多改变。

items.front: There's a pub just around the corner.
items.meaning: 在轉角有一家酒吧。

items.front: It is true that she is pretty, but she is selfish.
items.meaning: 她确实很漂亮，但她很自私。

items.front: I am positive that he is wrong.
items.meaning: 我確定他是錯的。

items.front: It is true Wendy grew up at the seaside, but she isn't a good swimmer.
items.meaning: 溫迪的確是在海邊長大的，但是她卻不太會游泳。

items.front: I admit this may not be the best way of doing it.
items.meaning: 我承认这可能不是最好的方法。

items.front: A nuclear war will bring about the destruction of mankind.
items.meaning: 核戰爭將會為人類帶來滅亡。

items.front: All humanity will suffer if a nuclear war breaks out.
items.meaning: 一旦爆發核戰爭，受苦的將會是全人類。

items.front: Each robot is equipped with a talking machine.
items.meaning: 每個機器人身上都安裝了一台發聲器。

items.front: There's an old movie theater in town.
items.meaning: 城裡有一家古老的電影院。

items.front: Let's have lunch downtown and take in a show.
items.meaning: 我們去市區吃飯，然後再看場電影吧。

items.front: Generally speaking, the climate of Japan is mild.
items.meaning: 总体上说，日本的气候温和。

items.front: Generally speaking, women are better linguists than men.
items.meaning: 总体上说，女人是比男人好的语言学家。

items.front: Generally speaking, women live longer than men.
items.meaning: 一般来说，女人活得比男人久。

items.front: Generally speaking, Americans are very fond of coffee.
items.meaning: 美國人一般都很喜歡喝咖啡。

items.front: Generally speaking, men are stronger than women.
items.meaning: 男人一般都比女人強壯。

items.front: Generally speaking, boys can run faster than girls.
items.meaning: 一般来说，男生跑得比女生快。

items.front: Save it on the external hard drive.
items.meaning: 把它保存在外接式硬碟。

items.front: Comb your hair before you go out.
items.meaning: 在你出門之前，把你的頭髮梳一梳。

items.front: Make sure to turn off all the lights before going out.
items.meaning: 出去之前确认一下所有的灯都关了。

items.front: I don't have a prejudice against foreign workers.
items.meaning: 我对外籍员工没有偏见。

items.front: It is not easy to learn a foreign language.
items.meaning: 学会一门外语不容易。

items.front: It's difficult to learn a foreign language.
items.meaning: 学一门外语是很难的。

items.front: It takes years to master a foreign language.
items.meaning: 學外語要花好幾年的時間才能學得精通。

items.front: A foreign language cannot be mastered in a year or so.
items.meaning: 一個外國語言無法在一年左右就被掌握。

items.front: Mastering a foreign language calls for patience.
items.meaning: 精通一種外語需要耐心。

items.front: Mastering a foreign language involves a lot of patience.
items.meaning: 学好一门外语需要坚韧不拔的毅力。

items.front: It is not until you go abroad that you realize how small Japan is.
items.meaning: 你出國看看，才會知道日本是多麼的細小。

items.front: The number of people who go abroad has been increasing.
items.meaning: 出国的人数一直在增加。

items.front: Visiting a foreign country must be expensive.
items.meaning: 到外國一定很貴。

items.front: It's fun to learn about foreign cultures.
items.meaning: 學習外國文化是件有趣的事。

items.front: Have you visited foreign countries, say America?
items.meaning: 你有出國過嗎？譬如說，美國？

items.front: An ambassador is an honest man sent to lie abroad for the good of his country.
items.meaning: 大使是为了本国的利益被派去外国撒谎的正直的人。

items.front: Don't judge a person by his appearance.
items.meaning: 不要以貌取人。

items.front: No sooner had I gone out than it began to rain.
items.meaning: 我一出門就開始下雨了。

items.front: Keep your eyes closed until I tell you to open them.
items.meaning: 闭着你的眼睛直到我告诉你睁开为止。

items.front: Drawing is a lot of fun; it helps me to relax.
items.meaning: 画画能带给我很多乐趣，也能让我放松自己。

items.front: The picture looks better at a distance.
items.meaning: 这幅画远看更好。

items.front: Everyone says that he's a good man.
items.meaning: 大家都說他是個好人。

items.front: They regarded him as the best doctor in town.
items.meaning: 他们把他视为城里最好的医生。

items.front: Everybody wished he had been elected governor.
items.meaning: 每個人都希望他當選州長。

items.front: Everyone opposed it, but they got married all the same.
items.meaning: 他們不理眾人的反對結了婚。

items.front: All of you are familiar with the truth of the story.
items.meaning: 你們所有的人都熟悉這個故事的真相。

items.front: Throw a sprat to catch a whale.
items.meaning: 丟鲱鱼抓鯨魚。

items.front: The pirates buried their treasure in the ground.
items.meaning: 海盗把財寶藏進了地底。

items.front: There were few people on the beach.
items.meaning: 沙灘上的人非常少。

items.front: We'll have a barbecue at the beach.
items.meaning: 我們要在海邊烤肉。

items.front: I had a chance to travel abroad.
items.meaning: 我有個到國外旅遊的機會。

items.front: Canada is a good place to go if it's your first experience living abroad.
items.meaning: 如果你是第一次到外國生活的話，加拿大會很適合你。

items.front: Neptune is the eighth planet of the solar system.
items.meaning: 海王星是太阳系第八个行星。

items.front: Oceans do not so much divide the world as unite it.
items.meaning: 海洋不是将世界分隔开来，而是将世界连接起来

items.front: I have plenty of money with me.
items.meaning: 我身上帶著很多錢。

items.front: Would you please replace the broken one promptly?
items.meaning: 请快点把碎了的那个换掉好吗？

items.front: Being a good conversationalist does not just mean being a good speaker of English.
items.meaning: 作為一個良好的交談者，並不只意味著作一個英語說得好的說話者。

items.front: Cross off the names of the people who have paid their dues.
items.meaning: 麻煩你把付了錢的人的名字刪掉。

items.front: The hall was filled with such a large audience that there wasn't even standing room.
items.meaning: 會堂裏擠滿了聽眾，連一點站立的空間也沒有。

items.front: On behalf of the company, I would like to express our hearty thanks to you all.
items.meaning: 在此僅代表本公司向各位致上衷心的謝意。

items.front: Management of a company is different from ownership of a company.
items.meaning: 管理一間公司和擁有一間公司是不能相提並論的兩回事。

items.front: The firm went under due to lack of capital.
items.meaning: 公司由于缺乏资本倒闭了。

items.front: The office has been topsy-turvy since the merger upset everything.
items.meaning: 自從公司合併了以後，一切都變得十分混亂。

items.front: The community is made up of individuals.
items.meaning: 社會是由個人組成的。

items.front: I suggested that we bring the meeting to an end.
items.meaning: 我建议让我们结束会议。

items.front: We got the meeting over with quickly.
items.meaning: 我們很快的結束了這個會議。

items.front: The meeting will take place next Sunday.
items.meaning: 会议将在下周日召开。

items.front: The meeting is held twice a month.
items.meaning: 一个月开两次会。

items.front: I will tell her what to say at the meeting.
items.meaning: 我会告诉她开会的时候说些什么。

items.front: Pay the cashier on the way out.
items.meaning: 在出口處的收银台付款。

items.front: The conference is to be held in Tokyo.
items.meaning: 會議將在東京舉行。

items.front: Meetings are to be held on the afternoon of July 15 (Tuesday), all day July 16 (Wednesday), and the morning of July 17 (Thursday).
items.meaning: 會議將會在七月十五日（星期二）的下午、七月十六日（星期三）的全天和七月十七日（星期四）的早上舉行。

items.front: At the meeting he monopolized the discussion and completely disrupted the proceeding.
items.meaning: 在這次會議上, 他壟斷了討論並徹底打亂了議程。

items.front: Are you going to attend the meeting?
items.meaning: 你要參加會議嗎？

items.front: Ask him if he will attend the meeting.
items.meaning: 问他会不会来参加会议。

items.front: Not all of us can speak English.
items.meaning: 我們並不是全部都會講英語。

items.front: We rowed up the river against the current.
items.meaning: 我們在河裏划著船逆流而上。

items.front: We carried on the discussion till late at night.
items.meaning: 我們一直討論到很晚。

items.front: We were attacked by swarms of bees.
items.meaning: 我們被一大群蜜蜂攻擊。

items.front: We hadn't so much as heard of her name.
items.meaning: 我們連她的名字也沒有聽過。

items.front: We were all greatly amused by his jokes.
items.meaning: 我們都被他的笑話逗得很開心。

items.front: We should have told him the truth.
items.meaning: 我們應該告訴他真相的。

items.front: We should have taken the schedule into consideration.
items.meaning: 我们本该考虑一下行程。

items.front: We must sleep at least eight hours a day.
items.meaning: 我们每天至少该睡八小时。

items.front: We've become a mockery to the whole village.
items.meaning: 我们成了整个村庄的笑柄。

items.front: We debated on the question of world population.
items.meaning: 我們在世界人口問題上爭辯了一番。

items.front: We cleared a path through the woods.
items.meaning: 我們在森林裏開了一條路。

items.front: We must always be prepared for disasters.
items.meaning: 我们必须始终为灾害做好准备。

items.front: We failed due to a lack of preparation.
items.meaning: 我們因缺乏準備而失敗了。

items.front: We should sometimes expose our bodies to the sun.
items.meaning: 我們閒時應該出外曬曬太陽。

items.front: We have to make a close analysis of the accident.
items.meaning: 我們要詳細的分析一下意外發生的前因後果。

items.front: We have to get at the truth of the matter.
items.meaning: 我們必須知道事情的真相。

items.front: We were filled with anger against the murderer.
items.meaning: 我們對殺人犯感到悲憤填膺。

items.front: We left the final decision to him.
items.meaning: 我們讓他做最後的決定。

items.front: We found the footprints in the sand.
items.meaning: 我們發現了沙灘上的腳印。

items.front: We've been matched up with some strong teams this year.
items.meaning: 我們今年和不少強隊交過手。

items.front: We are in the era of atomic energy.
items.meaning: 我們身在原子能時代。

items.front: We got involved in a traffic accident.
items.meaning: 我們被捲入了一場交通事故。

items.front: We will never give in to terrorist demands.
items.meaning: 我們決不會屈服於恐怖份子的要求之下。

items.front: We got an interesting piece of information.
items.meaning: 我們得到了一份有趣的情報。

items.front: We hoped to have done with the work before the holidays.
items.meaning: 我们希望在放假前做完了工作。

items.front: We have to cope with hosts of difficulties.
items.meaning: 我們要面對許多的困難。

items.front: We all wondered why she had dumped such a nice man.
items.meaning: 我們都想知道她為什麼甩了這麼好的一個男人。

items.front: We were all amused with the comedy.
items.meaning: 我们都被这出喜剧逗乐了。

items.front: We eat a meal three times a day.
items.meaning: 我们一日三餐。

items.front: We gained the top of Mt. Fuji at last.
items.meaning: 我们终于登上了富士山山顶。

items.front: We associate Darwin with the theory of evolution.
items.meaning: 一提到進化論，我們就會想起達爾文。

items.front: We were watching the child at play.
items.meaning: 我们看着这孩子玩耍。

items.front: We talked over the plan with him.
items.meaning: 我們和他談了這個計劃。

items.front: We gave the performer a round of applause.
items.meaning: 我们为表演者鼓掌。

items.front: We've come to the conclusion that this is a true story.
items.meaning: 我們的結論就是，那個傳言是真的。

items.front: We made fun of him about this.
items.meaning: 我們取笑了他這一點。

items.front: We should always act in obedience to the law.
items.meaning: 我們無論如何也應該遵守法律。

items.front: We hired a car for a week when we were in Italy.
items.meaning: 我们在意大利的时候，租车用了一个礼拜 。

items.front: Are we making a nonstop flight to the U.S.?
items.meaning: 我们是不是直飞美国？

items.front: We got to the station at six.
items.meaning: 我們六點鐘到了車站。

items.front: Newspapers, magazines, and newscasts tell what is going on in the world.
items.meaning: 报纸、杂志和新闻广播讲述着世界上正在发生的事。

items.front: Our eyes take time to adjust to the darkness.
items.meaning: 我们的眼睛需要时间来适应黑暗。

items.front: Our plane took off exactly on time at six.
items.meaning: 我們的飛機準時在六時正起飛了。

items.front: Our new head office is in Tokyo.
items.meaning: 我們的新總部位於東京。

items.front: Our plans are to advance toward the city.
items.meaning: 我們的計劃是向都市前進。

items.front: Our school is very close to the park.
items.meaning: 我们学校离公园非常近。

items.front: Initially we had some problems with our computer system, but they've been sorted out now.
items.meaning: 我們的電腦系統起初出了點問題，不過現在已經修理好了。

items.front: We are not short of oil in this country.
items.meaning: 我们国家不缺石油。

items.front: Give us the tools, and we'll finish the job.
items.meaning: 给我们工具，我们会完成工作。

items.front: We had a slight difference of opinion.
items.meaning: 我們的看法有一點不同。

items.front: As we went around the corner, the lake came into view.
items.meaning: 当我们走到转角处，湖就映入了眼帘。

items.front: We're thoroughly prepared for the Y2K bug.
items.meaning: 我們已經準備好應付千年蟲。

items.front: We are expecting an addition to our family.
items.meaning: 我們家快要添丁了。

items.front: I got a lot of mosquito bites.
items.meaning: 我被很多的蚊子叮了。

items.front: What with fatigue and lack of sleep, he has fallen ill at last.
items.meaning: 他疲勞過度，又睡眠不足，最後便病倒了。

items.front: We have experienced many changes over the last decade.
items.meaning: 我们最近十年经历了很多变化。

items.front: Have you ever had any serious illness?
items.meaning: 你曾经得过重病吗？

items.front: You must live in the present, not in the past.
items.meaning: 你一定要活在當下，不能總是留戀過去。

items.front: It's never too late to make amends.
items.meaning: 彌補永遠不會太晚。

items.front: It is no use crying over spilt milk.
items.meaning: 為濺出的牛奶哭也沒用。

items.front: I heard the manager's wife is on vacation. And, well, when the cat's away, the mice play. Now he's out partying every night.
items.meaning: 我听说经理的妻子出去度假了。这时就是山中无老虎，猴子称大王了。现在经理他夜夜笙箫。

items.front: Could you carry my bags for me?
items.meaning: 你可以幫我提我的袋子嗎?

items.front: Please put your baggage on this scale.
