items.front: How can I get to the station?
items.meaning: 我怎樣才能到火車站？

items.front: The station is not far from here.
items.meaning: 火车站离这里不远。

items.front: There is a post office in front of the station.
items.meaning: 车站前面有个邮局。

items.front: Is there a bank near the station?
items.meaning: 地铁站的附近有银行吗？

items.front: On his arrival at the station, he called a taxi.
items.meaning: 他到了火车站，就叫了辆出租车。

items.front: My brother was supposed to pick me up at the station, but I couldn't find him.
items.meaning: 我的弟弟應該會來車站接我的，但是我卻找不到他。

items.front: Please wait for me at the station.
items.meaning: 請在車站等我。

items.front: I'll drop you off at the station.
items.meaning: 我載你到車站。

items.front: Who did you see at the station?
items.meaning: 你在車站看見了誰?

items.front: English people rarely talk to strangers in the train.
items.meaning: 英國人很少在火車上和陌生人搭訕。

items.front: The British have a lot of respect for law and order.
items.meaning: 英國人很尊重法序和秩序。

items.front: England expects that every man will do his duty.
items.meaning: 英國期望每個人都會盡義務。

items.front: London, the capital of England, is on the Thames.
items.meaning: 英国首都伦敦在泰晤士河畔。

items.front: Speaking English is very difficult for me.
items.meaning: 說英語對我來說很困難。

items.front: She speaks English better than any of her classmates.
items.meaning: 她的英語說得比班上任何人都好。

items.front: Don't be afraid to make mistakes when speaking English.
items.meaning: 說英語的時候不要怕犯錯。

items.front: It is not difficult to speak English.
items.meaning: 說英語不難。

items.front: I found it easy to speak English.
items.meaning: 我發覺說英語很簡單。

items.front: Don't be afraid of making mistakes when you speak English.
items.meaning: 當你說英語的時候不要怕犯錯。

items.front: Don't be afraid of making mistakes when speaking English.
items.meaning: 讲英语的时候不要怕会不会说错什么。

items.front: It seems that the purpose of his study abroad was to improve his ability to speak English.
items.meaning: 看来他出国学习的目的是要提高他说英语的能力。

items.front: To speak English is not easy, but it is interesting.
items.meaning: 說英語不容易但它卻很有趣。

items.front: Speaking English is a lot of fun.
items.meaning: 說英語很有趣。

items.front: Don't translate English into Japanese word for word.
items.meaning: 不要逐字逐句的把英文翻譯成日文。

items.front: The position requires applicants to be skilled in spoken English.
items.meaning: 这份职位要求应征者有一定的英语口语表达能力。

items.front: When writing English, she rarely makes a mistake.
items.meaning: 她在英文书写上很少犯错。

items.front: It is not easy to master English.
items.meaning: 要精通英語不容易。

items.front: All students of English should have a good English-English dictionary at hand.
items.meaning: 所有學英語的學生應該隨手有一本好的英英詞典。

items.front: You're much less likely to get a good position if you don't speak English.
items.meaning: 如果你不会说英语，你就很难得到一个好的职位。

items.front: English is something to be learned step by step.
items.meaning: 英文是要一步一步的學的。

items.front: English is spoken in a lot of countries.
items.meaning: 英語是很多國家通用的語言。

items.front: English is spoken by more people than any other language.
items.meaning: 說英語的人比說任何其他語言的人多。

items.front: English has spread all over the country.
items.meaning: 英語已經普及全國。

items.front: English is spoken in many countries around the world.
items.meaning: 全世界許多國家的人說英語。

items.front: English is a language spoken all over the world.
items.meaning: 英語是一種全世界通用的語言。

items.front: English is studied all over the world.
items.meaning: 世界各地都讀英語。

items.front: English is by far the most widely-spoken language in the world.
items.meaning: 英語是目前在世界上使用最廣泛的語言。

items.front: English is a very important language in today's world.
items.meaning: 英语是当今世界上一种非常重要的语言。

items.front: English is just one of over 2,700 languages in the world today.
items.meaning: 今天，英語只是世界上超過2,700種語言的其中之一。

items.front: English has now become the common language of several nations in the world.
items.meaning: 英语现已成为世界上许多国家的通用语言了。

items.front: English is a universal language and is used all over the world.
items.meaning: 英語是一種世界性的語言，用於世界各地。

items.front: English is taught almost all over the world today.
items.meaning: 今天幾乎全世界都在教授英語。

items.front: English is useful in diplomacy and tourism.
items.meaning: 英語在外交和旅遊業方面很有用。

items.front: English is a kind of universal language.
items.meaning: 英語是一種世界語言。

items.front: English is too difficult for me to understand.
items.meaning: 英語對我來說太難理解了。

items.front: How are you getting along with your English study?
items.meaning: 你的英文學得如何？

items.front: I can't find any logic to English spelling. “Ghoti” can be pronounced as “fish.”
items.meaning: 我找不到任何英文拼寫的邏輯。"Ghoti" 可以被發音成"fish"。

items.front: In addition to English, he can speak French.
items.meaning: 除了英语，他还会说法语。

items.front: Some students like English, and others like physics.
items.meaning: 有些学生喜欢英语，有些喜欢物理。

items.front: In addition to English, he speaks German.
items.meaning: 除了英文，他還說德文。

items.front: Did you ever make a speech in English?
items.meaning: 你曾經用英語演講過嗎？

items.front: As far as English is concerned, nobody can beat me.
items.meaning: 在英語能力方面，沒有人能比我好。

items.front: Many English words are derived from Latin.
items.meaning: 許多英文單字源自於拉丁文。

items.front: It is fun to speak in English.
items.meaning: 说英语很有趣。

items.front: Do you have a book written in English?
items.meaning: 你有一本用英文寫的書嗎？

items.front: To write a love letter in English is not easy.
items.meaning: 用英文寫情書是不容易的。

items.front: What do you call this bird in English?
items.meaning: 这鸟你们用英语怎么称呼？

items.front: Yamada is second to none in English in his class.
items.meaning: 山田的英語在他的班上是首屈一指的。

items.front: What do you call this insect in English?
items.meaning: 这种昆虫在英语中叫什么？

items.front: Smoking is not permitted in the cinema.
items.meaning: 電影院內不准吸煙。

items.front: The movie was interesting, as I had expected.
items.meaning: 不出我所料，那部電影相當有趣。

items.front: Let's stop off and see a movie.
items.meaning: 讓我們中途下車看場電影吧。

items.front: We must not speak ill of others behind their backs.
items.meaning: 我們不應該在背後說別人的壞話。

items.front: Our store hours are from 10 to 7.
items.meaning: 我們的營業時間是十時至七時。

items.front: The clouds opened and the sun shone through.
items.meaning: 云开见天日。

items.front: The moon is invisible behind the clouds.
items.meaning: 在雲的遮蔽下無法見到月亮。

items.front: Luckily he had enough money to pay the bill.
items.meaning: 幸运的是他有足够的钱来付账。

items.front: I would rather kill myself than reconcile myself to my fate.
items.meaning: 与其向命运妥协，我宁可自杀。

items.front: Having a driver's license is an advantage for this job.
items.meaning: 有駕照者優先得到這個職位。

items.front: May I see your driver's license, sir?
items.meaning: 先生，我可以看看你的駕駛執照嗎？

items.front: He amazed everyone by passing his driving test.
items.meaning: 他通過駕駛考試的事讓每一個人都覺得驚訝。

items.front: He managed to pass his driving test even though he was a poor driver.
items.meaning: 他的駕駛技術很差，但也勉強通過了駕駛考試。

items.front: Unfortunately, the telephone was out of order.
items.meaning: 不幸的是電話壞了。

items.front: Speak of angels and you hear their wings.
items.meaning: 說到天使，你就聽到他們翅膀揮動的聲音。

items.front: It is wrong to tell a lie.
items.meaning: 說謊是錯誤的。

items.front: Many a true word is spoken in jest.
items.meaning: 笑談之中有至理。

items.front: Do you have rain gear with you?
items.meaning: 你有沒有帶雨具？

items.front: The rain shows no sign of stopping.
items.meaning: 这雨没有要停的迹象。

items.front: I go to the office by bicycle except on rainy days.
items.meaning: 除了雨天，我都是骑车去上班的。

items.front: I like to walk in the rain.
items.meaning: 我喜歡在雨中漫步。

items.front: A bicycle will rust if you leave it in the rain.
items.meaning: 如果你把自行車留在雨中，它會生鏽的。

items.front: I feel like singing in the rain.
items.meaning: 真想在雨中放声歌唱。

items.front: In case it rains, I won't go.
items.meaning: 萬一下雨，我就不去。

items.front: Take your coat in case it rains.
items.meaning: 带上你的外套以防下雨。

items.front: I stayed home because of the rain.
items.meaning: 因為下雨，所以我待在家裡。

items.front: Rain prevented us from taking a walk.
items.meaning: 雨讓我們沒有辦法去散步。

items.front: The game was called off on account of the rain.
items.meaning: 比賽因為下雨取消了。

items.front: The baseball game was called off due to rain.
items.meaning: 棒球比賽因為天雨取消了。

items.front: Besides the rain, we experienced heavy winds.
items.meaning: 除了雨之外，我们体验了强风。

items.front: He went out in spite of the rain.
items.meaning: 尽管下着雨，他还是出去了。

items.front: He said that he was afraid it would be rainy.
items.meaning: 他说他怕天会下雨。

items.front: It looks like rain. We had better shut the windows.
items.meaning: 好像快要下雨了。我們把窗關上吧。

items.front: You may go cycling if it doesn't rain.
items.meaning: 如果不下雨的話，你可以去踏單車。

items.front: The rain is beating against the windows.
items.meaning: 雨点打着窗户。

items.front: We won't go out unless it stops raining.
items.meaning: 除非雨停了，我们才会出去。

items.front: Every time it rains, the roof leaks.
items.meaning: 每次下雨屋頂就漏水。

items.front: Don't forget to take an umbrella in case it rains.
items.meaning: 如果下雨的話，別忘了帶把傘。

items.front: It was raining, and Joe's long hair was completely wet by the time he got home.
items.meaning: 那時正在下雨，而 Joe 回到家時長髮已濕透了。

items.front: Catherine stayed indoors because it was raining.
items.meaning: 因為外面正在下雨，所以 Catherine 留在室內。

items.front: In spite of the heavy rain, he decided to go out.
items.meaning: 雖然下着大雨，但是他還是決定了要出外。

items.front: He closed the window for fear of rain.
items.meaning: 他怕會下雨，所以就把窗關上了。

items.front: I found a bird whose wing was severely damaged.
items.meaning: 我發現了一隻翅膀受了重傷的鳥兒。

items.front: Space travel will be commonplace some time in the future.
items.meaning: 太空旅行終有一天會成為平常事。

items.front: There are many galaxies in the universe.
items.meaning: 在宇宙中有很多星系。

items.front: Seen from space, the earth is very beautiful.
items.meaning: 從太空裏看，地球是個十分美麗的星球。

items.front: I think my right arm is broken.
items.meaning: 我想我的右手臂斷了。

items.front: Turning to the right, you will find the city hall in front of you.
items.meaning: 向右转，你就可以看到市政厅位于正前方。

items.front: You have your right sock on wrong side out.
items.meaning: 你右邊襪子倒轉穿了。

items.front: You shouldn't talk about people behind their backs.
items.meaning: 你不應該在背後說別人的壞話。

items.front: I would like to order drinks now.
items.meaning: 我現在想點飲料。

items.front: On the one hand we suffered a heavy loss, but on the other hand we learned a great deal from the experience.
items.meaning: 一方面我们虽然蒙受了损失，但另一方面我们从这次经验中学到了很多。

items.front: On the one hand, you are wrong, but on the other hand, I can't blame you for that.
items.meaning: 你固然是錯了，但也不能怪你。

items.front: What do you say to taking a rest?
items.meaning: 不如休息一下吧？

items.front: Some babies learn to swim even before they are one year old.
items.meaning: 有些宝宝甚至在一岁之前就学习游泳了。

items.front: I got up early in order to catch the first train.
items.meaning: 我為了乘頭班火車，一大早就起了床。

items.front: How much is the most expensive car?
items.meaning: 最贵的车多少钱？

items.front: Where is the nearest lost and found?
items.meaning: 離這裏最近的失物招領處在哪裏？

items.front: Can you tell me where the nearest bus stop is?
items.meaning: 你能把最近的公车站指给我看吗?

items.front: I'd like to know the phone number of the nearest American Express office.
items.meaning: 我想知道最近的美國運通辦事處的電話號碼。

items.front: It was raining on and off all night long.
items.meaning: 整晚一會下雨，一會停雨。

items.front: I wonder whether man could live with only two hours' sleep a night.
items.meaning: 不知道人每晚只睡兩個小時，能不能生存下去呢？

items.front: Generally speaking, men are physically stronger than women.
items.meaning: 一般说来，男生的肌肉比女生发达。

items.front: In general, consumers prefer quantity to quality.
items.meaning: 一般來說，消费者喜歡數量勝於質量。

items.front: The Japanese at large consider themselves better off than they used to be.
items.meaning: 日本人一般都覺得自己的生活比以前過得好。

items.front: New Year's Day is the key to the year.
items.meaning: 元旦是一年的關鍵。

items.front: I only missed one day of work because of a cold and my desk is piled high with papers.
items.meaning: 我才感冒一天没来上班，桌上就堆满了文件。

items.front: I had to stay in bed all day.
items.meaning: 我不得不一整天都呆在床上。

items.front: I find it difficult to do all this work in a day.
items.meaning: 我觉得很难用一天时间做完所有这些工作。

items.front: On behalf of the company, I welcome you.
items.meaning: 我代表公司歡迎你的來臨。

items.front: Once across the river, you are safe.
items.meaning: 一旦過了河, 你就安全了。

items.front: I can't do two things at a time.
items.meaning: 我不能一心二用。

items.front: Rome was not built in a day.
items.meaning: 罗马不是一天建成的。

items.front: A car passed by at top speed.
items.meaning: 一辆车全速经过。

items.front: To kill two birds with one stone.
items.meaning: 一石二鸟。

items.front: At one time, people would not have hesitated to light up a cigarette in stations, restaurants, or hospital waiting rooms.
items.meaning: 在以前的人的眼中，在車站、餐廳、醫院的等候室裏抽煙並沒有甚麼問題。

items.front: If he studied hard, he would pass the test.
items.meaning: 如果他努力学习，他会通过考试的。

items.front: You can make your dream come true by working hard.
items.meaning: 你努力工作的話，就可以實現你的夢想。

items.front: I ran as fast as I could.
items.meaning: 我尽力奔跑。

items.front: You can't get ahead if you don't work hard.
items.meaning: 一分耕耘，一分收获。

items.front: I'm trying hard, but can't think of her name.
items.meaning: 我怎麼想也想不起她的名字。

items.front: All the workers went home save one.
items.meaning: 所有的员工都回家了，只剩一位。

items.front: An old man broke into our conversation.
items.meaning: 一位老人打斷了我們的談話。

items.front: A boy is walking across the street.
items.meaning: 一个男孩正沿着街走。

items.front: Though she wished to travel abroad by herself, she thought better of it.
items.meaning: 儘管她想過一個人去國外旅行，她改變了主意。

items.front: Can you move this desk by yourself?
items.meaning: 你能自己搬這張桌子嗎?

items.front: The admission is ten dollars a person.
items.meaning: 入場費一個人10美元。

items.front: I'm sorry for your not having come with us.
items.meaning: 我很遗憾您没有和我们一起来。

items.front: Come along with me and go fishing.
items.meaning: 跟我一起去钓鱼。

items.front: Would you like to go see a movie with me?
items.meaning: 不如一起去看電影吧。

items.front: With great effort he climbed up the tree.
items.meaning: 他费了不少劲，爬上了那棵树。

items.front: I was in the hospital for a week.
items.meaning: 我住了一個星期的醫院。

items.front: I went without food for a week.
items.meaning: 我一星期沒帶食物去。

items.front: We have five English classes a week.
items.meaning: 我们一周有五节英语课。

items.front: Ten to one it'll clear up in an hour or so.
items.meaning: 天氣八成在一個小時之內就會放晴。

items.front: Scarcely an hour goes by that I don't I think of you with love.
items.meaning: 我幾乎沒有一個小時不滿懷愛意地想著你。

items.front: They left there the day before yesterday.
items.meaning: 前天，他们离开了那儿。

items.front: There is no time to be lost.
items.meaning: 沒有時間浪費。

items.front: At first glance, the question seemed easy.
items.meaning: 第一眼看起來，那個問題似乎很容易。

items.front: January is the first month of the year.
items.meaning: 一月是一年之中的頭一個月。

items.front: A word is enough to a wise man.
items.meaning: 對聰明人說話，一語即足。

items.front: I don't like being made a fool of.
items.meaning: 我不喜欢被人愚弄。

items.front: One is new, and the other is old.
items.meaning: 一个是新的，另一个是旧的。

items.front: To know a language is one thing, and to teach it is another.
items.meaning: 知道一门语言是一回事，教这门语言又是另一回事。

items.front: I have a favor to ask of you.
items.meaning: 我想你幫我做一件事。

items.front: There was little water in the well.
items.meaning: 這口井裡的水很少。

items.front: Do you think we should send for the doctor?
items.meaning: 你認為我們應該派人去請醫生來嗎?

items.front: The doctor told her that she should take a rest.
items.meaning: 医生告诉她要静养。

items.front: The doctor cured him of his cancer.
items.meaning: 醫生治好了他的癌症。

items.front: The doctor advised him to do more exercise.
items.meaning: 醫生建議他多做運動。

items.front: The doctor advised me to stop smoking.
items.meaning: 醫生勸我戒煙。

items.front: The doctor advised me to give up smoking.
items.meaning: 医生建议我戒烟。

items.front: The doctor continued to observe the patient's behavior.
items.meaning: 醫生繼續觀察病人的一舉一動。

items.front: The doctor administered medicine to the patient.
items.meaning: 医生向病人用药。

items.front: The doctor used X-rays to examine my stomach.
items.meaning: 醫生用X光檢查我的胃。

items.front: All the doctor's efforts were in vain and the man soon died.
items.meaning: 醫生雖然已經竭盡全力，但不久病人還是死了。

items.front: You had better do as the doctor advised you.
items.meaning: 你最好照着医生的建议做。

items.front: I think you should see a doctor.
items.meaning: 我覺得你應該去看醫生。

items.front: Is it right for a doctor to decide when someone should die?
items.meaning: 由医生来决定某人何时该死是对的吗？

items.front: Doctors refused to perform a second operation.
items.meaning: 医生们拒绝做第二次手术。

items.front: The difference is this: he works harder than you.
items.meaning: 不同之處在於: 他比你更努力工作。

items.front: I got a stomach tumor and had to have it operated on.
items.meaning: 我得了胃腫瘤，必須動手術切除。

items.front: Do you feel any pain in your stomach?
items.meaning: 你的胃會痛嗎?

items.front: The emigrants have endured physical and mental pain.
items.meaning: 移民们忍受着肉体和精神的痛苦。

items.front: Years of resistance to misfortune ended when the settlers' village was overcome by the savages and their hopes and lives came to the bitter end.
items.meaning: 当移居者的村庄被野蛮人征服后，他们的希望和生活到了痛苦的尽头，数年对灾祸的抵抗结束了。

items.front: Could you say that in plain English?
items.meaning: 你會說簡單的英語嗎？

items.front: Knowing their languages is not enough to communicate effectively, because the methods of communication are determined by their cultures.
items.meaning: 要和他們有效地溝通，只懂得說他們的語言是不夠的，因為溝通的方式是由他們的文化來決定的。

items.front: Having no will is the worst handicap.
items.meaning: 没有愿望是最大的障碍。

items.front: The committee is composed of three men and seven women.
items.meaning: 委員會是由三男七女組成的。

items.front: The committee inquired into the cause of the accident.
items.meaning: 委员会调查了事故的原因。

items.front: Every great writer seems to have been interested in English.
items.meaning: 每一個偉大的作家似乎已經對英語感興趣。

items.front: Miss Ito made her students work hard.
items.meaning: 伊藤小姐要她的學生們努力學習。

items.front: "He used to love me," she answered sadly.
items.meaning: 他以前愛我，她傷心地回答。

items.front: It used to be thought that the earth was flat.
items.meaning: 以前的人以為地球是平的。

items.front: There used to be a church here.
items.meaning: 這裏以前有一間教堂。

items.front: I may have seen that film before, but I can hardly remember it.
items.meaning: 我以前可能看過這部電影，但是我卻不怎麼記得了。

items.front: The following is a summary of the President's speech.
items.meaning: 下面是总统讲话的概要。

items.front: The explanation below was achieved by comparing and contrasting a variety of different theories.
items.meaning: 下面的解釋是通過比較和對比各種不同的理論。

items.front: It is too dark to see clearly.
items.meaning: 太暗了，看不清楚。

items.front: It's getting dark. Please turn the light on for me.
items.meaning: 天色開始暗了。麻煩你幫我開燈。

items.front: It is getting dark. Let's go home.
items.meaning: 天漸漸黑了。我們回家吧。

items.front: Don't let her go out after dark.
items.meaning: 天黑後不要讓她出門。

items.front: Dark as it was, we managed to find our way home.
items.meaning: 天色很暗，但我們還是找到路回家。

items.front: Dark clouds are a sign of rain.
items.meaning: 乌云是下雨的征兆。

items.front: On entering a dark tunnel, we could see nothing.
items.meaning: 走進了漆黑的隧道後，我們甚麼也看不見。

items.front: You should drive at a safe speed.
items.meaning: 你應該以安全速度駕駛。

items.front: I feel as if I've woken up from a nightmare.
items.meaning: 我覺得我好像從惡夢中驚醒。

items.front: Speak of the devil and he is sure to appear.
items.meaning: 说曹操，曹操就到。

items.front: Due to bad weather, the plane was late.
items.meaning: 由于天气恶劣，飞机延误了。

items.front: A bad habit, once formed, is difficult to get rid of.
items.meaning: 一旦養成了壞習慣，就很難改回來了。

items.front: I'm sorry, but it's just not possible.
items.meaning: 我很抱歉, 但它就是不可能的。

items.front: At last, Mario managed to win the princess's love.
items.meaning: 最後，馬里奧設法贏得公主的愛。

items.front: Ai finds it difficult to make friends with Ken.
items.meaning: 艾发现和开恩交朋友很难。

items.front: Love is seeing her in your dreams.
items.meaning: 爱便是在你的梦中梦见她。

items.front: To love and to be loved is the greatest happiness.
items.meaning: 愛和被愛是人生最大的樂事。

items.front: It is the greatest happiness in life to love and to be loved.
items.meaning: 愛和被愛是生活中最大的幸福。

items.front: As long as we love each other, we'll be all right.
items.meaning: 只要我們彼此相愛，我們會沒事的。

items.front: We must not laugh at the poor.
items.meaning: 我们不能嘲笑穷人。

items.front: We must work as long as we live.
items.meaning: 我們要活到老，做到老。

items.front: We lost sight of the man in the crowd.
items.meaning: 在人群中，我们失去了那个男人的踪影。

items.front: We must try to break the deadlock.
items.meaning: 我们必须设法打破这个僵局。

items.front: We are all looking forward to seeing you and your family.
items.meaning: 我们都期待看到你和你的家人。

items.front: We must study the affair as a whole.
items.meaning: 我們必須總體地研究這事件。

items.front: We differ from them in some respects.
items.meaning: 我們有某些地方和他們不同。

items.front: Our world is only a small part of the universe.
items.meaning: 我們的世界只不過是宇宙的一小部分。

items.front: In our society we find men of integrity along with crooks.
items.meaning: 我們的社會良莠不齊。

items.front: We've received a lot of applications in answer to our advertisements.
items.meaning: 我們已經收到了很多回應我們廣告的申請。

items.front: I study about two hours every day.
items.meaning: 我每天讀書大約兩個小時。

items.front: I have a firm belief in his innocence.
items.meaning: 我堅信他是無辜的。

items.front: I have almost no money with me.
items.meaning: 我身上幾乎沒有錢。

items.front: I managed to get there in time.
items.meaning: 我設法及時到那裡。

items.front: I have nothing to do with the affair.
items.meaning: 我跟這件事無關。

items.front: I went to bed later than usual.
items.meaning: 我比平常睡得晚。

items.front: I took it that you would come.
items.meaning: 我以為你會來。

items.front: I lost the camera I had bought the day before.
items.meaning: 我把前一天才買的照相機弄不見了。

items.front: My house is only a mile from here.
items.meaning: 我的家離這裏只有一英里。

items.front: I have a friend whose father is a famous pianist.
items.meaning: 我有一個朋友，他的父親是位名鋼琴家。

items.front: I have a lot of work to do.
items.meaning: 我有很多工作要做。

items.front: We speak that we do know, and testify that we have seen; and ye receive not our witness.
items.meaning: 我們說我們所知道的，為我們所看到的作證；你們卻不接受我們的見證。

items.front: We've been horsing around too much; it's high time we got down to brass tacks.
items.meaning: 我們胡鬧太久了, 現在該是我們考慮基本事實的時候了。

items.front: Which is the capital of the United States, Washington or New York?
items.meaning: 美國的首都是華盛頓還是紐約？

items.front: Cherry trees are now in bloom in Washington.
items.meaning: 华盛顿的樱花现在开放。

items.front: It is kind of you go out of your way to help me.
items.meaning: 感謝你特地來幫我。

items.front: Do not bother to come to my home.
items.meaning: 不用特地來我家了。

items.front: There is a church near my house.
items.meaning: 我家附近有一座教堂。

items.front: I'd like to have a glass of wine.
items.meaning: 請給我一杯酒。

items.front: What number bus do I take to get to Waikiki?
items.meaning: 我乘几路车去怀基基？

items.front: Did you visit the Tower of London?
items.meaning: 你參觀倫敦塔了嗎？

items.front: The river that flows through London is the Thames.
items.meaning: 流经伦敦的河是泰晤士河。

items.front: I got on the train for London.
items.meaning: 我登上去伦敦的火车。

items.front: London was a city built for the horse.
items.meaning: 伦敦是一个为马而建立的城市。

items.front: London is among the largest cities in the world.
items.meaning: 倫敦是世界上最大的城市之一。

items.front: What time is it in London now?
items.meaning: 倫敦現在幾點鐘？

items.front: Do you know the concert schedule of London Symphony Orchestra?
items.meaning: 你知道伦敦交响乐团的演奏会行程吗？

items.front: London's climate differs from that of Tokyo.
items.meaning: 伦敦的气候和东京的不同。

items.front: On his arrival in London, he sent me a telegram.
items.meaning: 他一到伦敦就给我发了个电报。

items.front: Be sure to drop us a line as soon as you get to London.
items.meaning: 别忘了一到伦敦就给我们留言啊。

items.front: Long skirts are out of fashion now.
items.meaning: 現在長裙過時了。

items.front: Which do you like better, rock music or classical music?
items.meaning: 你比較喜歡哪一個，搖滾樂還是古典音樂？

items.front: Los Angeles is one of the places that I'd like to visit.
items.meaning: 洛杉磯是我想去的其中一個地方。

items.front: Interest on loans is high at present.
items.meaning: 现在的贷款利率很高。

items.front: Ms. Roland, what do you think about this problem?
items.meaning: Roland女士，你对这个问题怎么看？

items.front: Laura is very particular about her clothes.
items.meaning: 勞拉很講究她的服裝。

items.front: Laura Ingalls grew up on the prairie.
items.meaning: 勞拉英戈爾斯是在草原上長大的。

items.front: Rome is famous for its ancient architecture.
items.meaning: 羅馬以其古代建築而聞名。

items.front: Do in Rome as the Romans do.
items.meaning: 入乡随俗。

items.front: I'm looking for books on Roman history.
items.meaning: 我在找关于古罗马历史的书。

items.front: Rome has a lot of ancient buildings.
items.meaning: 罗马有很多古建筑。

items.front: May I have a road map, please?
items.meaning: 請給我一張路線圖。

items.front: The candle went out instead of having been put out.
items.meaning: 蜡烛是自己熄灭的，而不是被扑灭的。

items.front: Through the lens the image was inverted.
items.meaning: 图像在镜片中呈反向。

items.front: You should turn in your term papers by the end of April.
items.meaning: 請在四月底之前交上你的學期報告。

items.front: I was exhausted after running the race.
items.meaning: 賽跑完後我累透了。

items.front: Luciano might have the crowd behind him, but he's still wet behind the ears.
items.meaning: 虽然Luciano可能已经是出类拔萃，但他还是乳臭未干。

items.front: It was not until Lucy left me that I realized how much I loved her.
items.meaning: 直到露西離開了我，我才意識到我是多麼愛她。

items.front: Linda can dance as well as Meg.
items.meaning: 琳達舞可以跳得跟梅格一樣好。

items.front: Linda Wood was standing at the door.
items.meaning: 琳達伍德站在門口。

items.front: All the apple trees were cut down.
items.meaning: 所有苹果树都被砍倒了。

items.front: The apple tree has a beautiful blossom.
items.meaning: 苹果树上挂着美丽的花朵。

items.front: Which do you prefer, apples or bananas?
items.meaning: 你们比较喜欢什么，苹果还是香蕉？

items.front: Some apples fell down from the tree.
items.meaning: 有些蘋果從樹上掉了下來。

items.front: President Lincoln was what we call a self-made man.
items.meaning: 林肯總統就是我們所謂白手起家的男人。

items.front: Lincoln's parents remained poor all their lives.
items.meaning: 林肯的父母終其一生都很窮。

items.front: Recession is a temporary falling off of business activity during a period when such activity is generally increasing.
items.meaning: 经济萧条是一段时间内，当这样的经济活动普遍增长而造成的一种临时性的经济活动衰退。

items.front: Put down your name on the list and pass it on to the next person.
items.meaning: 把你的名字寫在名單上，然後把名單傳給下一個人。

items.front: Lisa speaks not only English but also French.
items.meaning: 丽萨不但会说英文，而且会说法文。

items.front: The lamp was suspended from the branch of a tree.
items.meaning: 灯笼在树枝上吊着。

items.front: Lansing is the state capital of Michigan.
items.meaning: 蘭辛是密西根州的首府。

items.front: Russell was a brilliant philosopher, but even the simplest practical task was quite beyond him.
items.meaning: 羅素是一個極出色的哲學家，可是他對日常生活中的事務卻是一竅不通。

items.front: Will you please turn down the radio?
items.meaning: 請你把收音機關小聲一點好嗎？

items.front: The communication of news by TV and radio is very common now.
items.meaning: 這個年代用電視和收音機報道新聞已是十分平常的事了。

items.front: Turn up the radio. I can't hear it.
items.meaning: 把收音機調大聲點。我聽不清楚。

items.front: According to the radio, it will snow tomorrow.
items.meaning: 据广播里讲，明天会下雪。

items.front: It was Marie Curie who discovered radium.
items.meaning: 鐳是居里夫人所發現的。

items.front: A camel is, so to speak, a ship on the desert.
items.meaning: 骆驼，这么说吧，也就是沙漠中的船。

items.front: A camel is to the desert what a ship is to the sea.
items.meaning: 駱駝是沙漠之舟。

items.front: The lions fought with each other to get food.
items.meaning: 狮子为了得到食物相互争斗。

items.front: The lion is the king of the jungle.
items.meaning: 狮子是丛林之王。

items.front: As the lion is king of beasts, so is the eagle king of birds.
items.meaning: 如果獅子是百獸之王的話，鷹就是百鳥之王了。

items.front: He that hears much and speaks not at all shall be welcome both in bower and hall.
items.meaning: 多聽不多言, 裡外人不嫌。

items.front: Put on your thinking cap and try to remember whose house you slept at last night.
items.meaning: 好好的想一想，看看能不能想起你昨晚是在誰家過夜的。

items.front: I wonder if you don't get tired of doing the same thing every day.
items.meaning: 你每天都是做一模一樣的東西，難道不會覺得悶嗎？

items.front: How dare you speak like that to me?
items.meaning: 你竟敢這樣和我說話？

items.front: Come along with us if you like.
items.meaning: 可以的话你也一起来吧。

items.front: While traveling in Europe, I was pickpocketed on a train.
items.meaning: 我去歐洲旅行的時候，在火車上給人偷了東西。

items.front: Europe has a smaller population than Asia.
items.meaning: 欧洲的人口比亚洲少。

items.front: The war in Europe was carried into Africa.
items.meaning: 战火烧到了非洲。

items.front: Instead of going to Europe, I decided to go to America.
items.meaning: 我决定去美国，而不是欧洲。

items.front: Are there many people in Europe who believe in ghosts even now?
items.meaning: 歐洲現在是不是還有很多人信鬼？

items.front: All right! You will be sorry for this.
items.meaning: 好！你会后悔的。

items.front: I'm glad you could come to the party.
items.meaning: 我很高兴你能来参加派对。

items.front: I am happy to have so many good friends.
items.meaning: 我很高興有這麼多好朋友。

items.front: The best fish smell when they are three days old.
items.meaning: 最好的鱼三天就要发臭。

items.front: To be a good batter, you've got to hang loose and follow your instincts.
items.meaning: 想成為一個好的擊球手的話，你要在球場上時刻保持鎮定，還要學會相信自己的直覺。

items.front: A smell of lilies filled the room.
items.meaning: 百合的香氣充滿了整個房間。

items.front: What is learned in the cradle is carried to the tomb.
items.meaning: 搖籃裡學的帶到墳墓。

items.front: Yumiko married a childhood friend last June.
items.meaning: 由美子去年六月嫁給了一個兒時的朋友。

items.front: Where is the United Airlines check-in counter?
items.meaning: 聯合航空公司辦理登機手續的櫃檯在哪裡？

items.front: Last night my house was robbed while I was still awake.
items.meaning: 昨晚我还没有睡觉家里就被小偷光顾了

items.front: I had a good sleep last night.
items.meaning: 我昨晚睡得很好。

items.front: I have a lot of homework to do.
items.meaning: 我有很多作业要做。

items.front: Do your best in anything you do.
items.meaning: 你做任何事都要尽全力。

items.front: I simply haven't the time to do everything I want to do.
items.meaning: 我有很多事想做，但就是沒時間做。

items.front: It has finally stopped snowing and has warmed up.
items.meaning: 雪終於停了，天氣也開始暖和了。

items.front: At last, the truth became known to us.
items.meaning: 真相終於大白。

items.front: So, we finally meet! I've waited so long for this moment.
items.meaning: 我們終於見面了！我等這一刻等了好久了。

items.front: You never know what you can do till you try.
items.meaning: 在你试过之前，你不会知道你能做什么。

items.front: It is the first step which is troublesome.
items.meaning: 第一步是最麻煩的。

items.front: Because it is written in simple English even a child can understand it.
items.meaning: 因為這是用簡單的英語寫的，所以甚至連孩子都能理解。

items.front: Written in easy English, the book is easy to read.
items.meaning: 這本書是用簡單英語寫成的，所以十分易讀。

items.front: Cool the burned finger in running water.
items.meaning: 用水沖洗灼傷的手指。

items.front: By and by he forgot that affair.
items.meaning: 他不久就把事情淡忘了。

items.front: It will not be long before we can know the truth of the matter.
items.meaning: 我們很快就可以知道事情的真相了。

items.front: By and by the party ended and everyone went home.
items.meaning: 不久派對完結，大家也都回家去了。

items.front: I do not need a loan anymore.
items.meaning: 我不需要贷款了。

items.front: More often than not, she had to go in person.
items.meaning: 很多時候她要親自去。

items.front: I wish I had more time to talk with her.
items.meaning: 我希望我能和她多谈一会儿。

items.front: We should judge matters on a broader basis.
items.meaning: 要有大局观。

items.front: Walk faster, or you'll miss the train.
items.meaning: 走快一點，不然你會錯過火車。

items.front: I'm sorry I didn't reply to you sooner.
items.meaning: 抱歉，我沒有早點回覆你。

items.front: Had I arrived earlier, I could have seen Kelly.
items.meaning: 如果我早點到，就能遇到凱莉了。

items.front: You ought to have come here earlier.
items.meaning: 你應該早點來的。

items.front: I could have done better if I had had more time.
items.meaning: 如果时间充裕，我可以做得更好的。

items.front: A more experienced lawyer would have dealt with the case in a different way.
items.meaning: 一个经验丰富的律师会以其它方法来处理这个情形的。

items.front: Could you put it in plain language?
items.meaning: 您可以简单点儿说吗？

items.front: You'll never achieve anything if you don't study harder.
items.meaning: 如果你不更加努力地學習, 你將永遠不會有所成就。

items.front: He asked me to speak more slowly.
items.meaning: 他要求我講慢一點。

items.front: Of course I accepted his offer of support.
items.meaning: 当然我接受了他的支援请求。

items.front: If it is fine tomorrow, we will play baseball.
items.meaning: 如果明天天氣好，我們就去打棒球。

items.front: What if he should happen to be late?
items.meaning: 萬一他遲到的話怎麼辨？

items.front: If a sick person folds one thousand paper cranes, her wish will come true.
items.meaning: 如果一個病人折一千隻紙鶴, 她的願望就會成真。

items.front: If her temperature goes up, send for the doctor.
items.meaning: 如果她的體溫上升, 派人去請醫生來。

items.front: If it had not been for his help, I would have failed.
items.meaning: 他没帮助我的话，我就失败了。

items.front: If I knew his address, I could write to him.
items.meaning: 如果我知道他的地址，就能寫信給他了。

items.front: We will help him if he asks us.
items.meaning: 如果他來找我們的話，我們是會幫忙的。

items.front: If he knew her phone number, he could call her.
items.meaning: 如果他知道她的电话，他会打给她。

items.front: I mean to go tomorrow if the weather is fine.
items.meaning: 如果天氣好的話，我打算明天出發。

items.front: If I could be reborn, I would want to be the child of a rich family, then I'd be set for life.
items.meaning: 如果可以投胎轉世的話，我想做有錢人家的兒子，一輩子衣食無憂。

items.front: If it were not for water, no one could live on earth.
items.meaning: 如果沒有了水，沒有人能夠在地球上生存。

items.front: If the car breaks down, we'll walk.
items.meaning: 如果車子壞了，我們就走路。

items.front: If time permits, I'll visit the museum.
items.meaning: 如果時間允許，我會去參觀博物館。

items.front: If you have time, please drop in on us.
items.meaning: 你有空就來看看我們吧。

items.front: If it were not for examinations, how happy our school life would be!
items.meaning: 如果不用考試，我們的校園生活該有多快樂啊！

items.front: It would be unfair if we treated him so badly.
items.meaning: 我們這樣待他，好像不是太好。

items.front: If I were a bird, I could fly to you.
items.meaning: 如果我是一隻小鳥，我就可以飛到你的身邊了。

items.front: If I had worked hard in my youth, I would be successful now.
items.meaning: 如果我年輕的時候努力工作, 我現在就成功了。

items.front: If I were to die, what would my family do?
items.meaning: 我死了，我家人怎么办。

items.front: If I were in your place, I would lend him a hand.
items.meaning: 如果我是你，我会帮他一把。

items.front: Had I known about it, I would have told you.
items.meaning: 如果我知道的话，我早就已经告诉你了。

items.front: If I had bought the painting then, I would be rich now.
items.meaning: 如果當時買了那幅畫，我現在就是一個富翁了。

items.front: Were I in your place I would do the same thing.
items.meaning: 如果我是你，我也会这么做。

items.front: If today was Sunday, I would go fishing.
items.meaning: 如果今天是星期日，我會去釣魚。

items.front: If I had one million yen now, I would buy a car.
items.meaning: 如果我现在有100万日元，我会买辆车。

items.front: You can go if you want to.
items.meaning: 如果你要你可以去。

items.front: If I lost my key, I wouldn't be able to lock the door.
items.meaning: 如果我弄丟了我的鑰匙，我就無法鎖門了。

items.front: If it had not been for your help, I couldn't have completed the work.
items.meaning: 如果不是因为有你的帮助，我不可能完成了这个工作。

items.front: I don't want to go if you don't go with me.
items.meaning: 如果你不一起去的話，我也不想去了。

items.front: If you hurry, you will catch up with him.
items.meaning: 如果你快一点，还能赶上他。

items.front: In case anything happens, call me immediately.
items.meaning: 如果發生了甚麼事，馬上打電話給我。

items.front: If you want a pencil, I'll lend you one.
items.meaning: 如果你需要铅笔，我借你一支。

items.front: He would be very glad to hear the news.
items.meaning: 他聽到這個消息，一定會很高興。

items.front: If it were not for the computer, how inconvenient our lives would be!
items.meaning: 如果沒有電腦的話，我們的生活會是多麼的不方便呢！

items.front: If you want this job, you must apply for it by tomorrow.
items.meaning: 如果你想要這份工作的話，就一定要在明天之前申請。

items.front: If you want to study in the United States, you need to get a student visa.
items.meaning: 你想去美國讀書的話，一定要先申請一張學生簽證。

items.front: If you do not go fishing tomorrow, I will not either.
items.meaning: 你明天不去釣魚的話，我也不去了。

items.front: I don't really like the stores there.
items.meaning: 我不是很喜歡那裡的商店。

items.front: You had better not go there again.
items.meaning: 你最好不要再去那裡。

items.front: You will be able to speak fluent English in another few months.
items.meaning: 再過兩、三個月，你就能說得一口流利的英語了。

items.front: I've got to hang up now. Someone is waiting to use the phone.
items.meaning: 我要掛線了。有人正在等著用電話。

items.front: Now that you're a college student, you should study harder.
items.meaning: 你現在是大學生了，應該努力點讀書。

items.front: I don't feel like waiting any longer.
items.meaning: 我不想繼續等了。

items.front: I have been reading this for a few hours.
items.meaning: 我一直讀這個讀了幾個小時。

items.front: You should get yourself a new car now.
items.meaning: 你該買輛新車了。

items.front: I wish I were a little taller.
items.meaning: 但願我長高一點。

items.front: If you had left home a little earlier you would have been in time.
items.meaning: 如果你早点出门的话，你就能赶上了。

items.front: Do you think you could make a little less noise?
items.meaning: 你觉得你能少发点噪音吗？

items.front: May I ask you some more questions?
items.meaning: 我可以問你一些問題嗎？

items.front: I wish I had a better memory.
items.meaning: 希望我的記憶力能好一點。

items.front: Do you have a room that's a little cheaper?
items.meaning: 你們有沒有比較便宜的房間？

items.front: Put some more wood on the fire.
items.meaning: 再往火裡添些木柴。

items.front: Why don't you stay a little while?
items.meaning: 你為什麼不留下來一會兒？

items.front: I gave up all hope of survival.
items.meaning: 我放棄了所有生存的希望。

items.front: It is time you left off your childish ways.
items.meaning: 是你该放弃你幼稚手段的时候了。

items.front: I don't want to hear any more excuses.
items.meaning: 我不想再听到其他借口了。

items.front: Have you arrived at a decision yet?
items.meaning: 你決定了沒有？

items.front: I guess I'll have to leave now.
items.meaning: 我想我現在得走了。

items.front: Now that it has stopped raining, we can go home.
items.meaning: 既然雨已经停了, 我们可以回家了.

items.front: With just a little more effort, he would have succeeded.
items.meaning: 如果他再努力一点，就可能已经成功了。

items.front: Another step, and you would have fallen down the stairs.
items.meaning: 再走一步的话，你就已经跌下楼梯了。

items.front: Another war, and we will be ruined.
items.meaning: 再來一場戰爭，我們就完蛋了。

items.front: I would like to talk with you again.
items.meaning: 我希望能再一次和你交谈。

items.front: Can I have the menu again, please?
items.meaning: 麻煩讓我再看看菜單好嗎？

items.front: Should he be given another chance, he would do his best.
items.meaning: 再給他一次機會的話，他會盡力做到最好的。

items.front: Why don't you give it another try?
items.meaning: 你為什麼不再試一次?

items.front: I want to go there once more.
items.meaning: 我想再去那裡一次。

items.front: I beg your pardon; I didn't quite catch your name.
items.meaning: 能再說一次嗎？我沒聽清楚你的名字。

items.front: I am anxious to visit Britain once again.
items.meaning: 我好想快點再去英國。

items.front: May I have another piece of cake?
items.meaning: 我可以再吃一塊蛋糕嗎？

items.front: It is time you went to bed. Turn off the radio.
items.meaning: 你该上床了。把收音机关了。

items.front: It's high time you left for school, isn't it?
items.meaning: 你現在該上學去了吧？

items.front: How about adding a little bit more salt?
items.meaning: 再加點鹽好嗎？

items.front: Could you please speak a little bit more slowly?
items.meaning: 能否請你說慢一點?

items.front: Do you want to stay any longer?
items.meaning: 你想再待下去嗎？

items.front: Let's not talk about it any more.
items.meaning: 讓我們不要再談論它了。

items.front: I was nearly hit by a car.
items.meaning: 我差點被車撞倒。

items.front: It is going to rain very soon.
items.meaning: 很快就要下雨了。

items.front: She does not eat cake, so as not to put on any more weight.
items.meaning: 她不想一直胖下去，所以正在戒吃蛋糕。

items.front: It would be better for both of us not to see each other anymore.
items.meaning: 我們還是不要再見面了。

items.front: There's no other way than this now.
items.meaning: 現在只剩下這個方法了。

items.front: It is time for you to go to bed.
items.meaning: 到了你该去睡觉的时候了。

items.front: I think we had better wait for another 30 minutes.
items.meaning: 我想我們還是再多等三十分鐘吧。

items.front: I wish to climb Mt. Fuji again.
items.meaning: 我希望再爬一次上富士山。

items.front: I'd like to stay one more night. Is that possible?
items.meaning: 我想还待一夜，行不行？

items.front: It's already eleven o'clock. I must be leaving now.
items.meaning: 現在已經十一時了。我一定要走了。

items.front: It's been almost ten years, but you're as beautiful as ever.
items.meaning: 過了差不多十年，你還是和以前一樣漂亮。

items.front: Did I tell you what Melissa said?
items.meaning: 我告訴過你梅利莎說的話嗎？

items.front: Mary made a cake without her mother's knowledge.
items.meaning: 瑪莉不讓母親知道，自己做了一個蛋糕。

items.front: There was a great variety of dishes on the menu.
items.meaning: 菜單上有各種各樣的菜色。

items.front: All you have to do is take advantage of this rare opportunity.
items.meaning: 你所要做的便是好好把握這千載難逢的機會。

items.front: Meg and Ken sat on the bench.
items.meaning: 梅格和肯坐在長椅上。

items.front: I couldn't make out what he meant by 'megafeps'.
items.meaning: 我不能明白他說的「megafeps」是甚麼意思。

items.front: I can't find my glasses. I may have left them behind on the train.
items.meaning: 我的眼鏡不見了。我大概是把它留在電車上了。

items.front: Mary took out the eggs one by one.
items.meaning: 瑪麗把雞蛋一顆一顆地取了出來。

items.front: Mary won't listen to her friend's advice.
items.meaning: 瑪麗不會聽她朋友的忠告。

items.front: Mary is going to help us tomorrow.
items.meaning: 瑪麗明天會幫我們。

items.front: Mary is not poor. On the contrary, she is quite rich.
items.meaning: 玛丽不穷，相反，她相当富裕。

items.front: Mary is at a loss what to say to him.
items.meaning: 瑪莉不知道該和他說甚麼才好。

items.front: Mary asked her son to behave himself.
items.meaning: 瑪麗要求她的兒子守規矩。

items.front: Mary went on a voyage around the world.
items.meaning: 玛丽去环游世界了。

items.front: Mary said she would do her homework.
items.meaning: 瑪麗說她會做她的功課。

items.front: Mary is very attached to the little girl.
items.meaning: 瑪莉很喜歡那個小女孩。

items.front: Mary set the basket on the table.
items.meaning: 瑪麗把籃子放在桌子上了。

items.front: Mary got the nod from among some 500 applicants.
items.meaning: 玛丽从大约500名申请者中脱颖而出。

items.front: When did you learn of Mary's divorce?
items.meaning: 你什麼時候獲知瑪麗離婚？

items.front: Speaking of Mary, I have not seen her for a long time.
items.meaning: 說起瑪莉，我已經有很久沒見過她了。

items.front: How did you get to know Mary?
items.meaning: 你怎麼認識瑪麗的？

items.front: We can see a church over there.
items.meaning: 我们可以看到那里的教堂。

items.front: The man reading a paper over there is my uncle.
items.meaning: 在那儿看报纸的男人是我叔叔。

items.front: Who is the boy that is swimming over there?
items.meaning: 在那邊游泳的男孩是誰？

items.front: There are some cookies in the jar.
items.meaning: 罐子裡有一些餅乾。

items.front: I was left out in the cold by everyone.
items.meaning: 我被每個人冷落。

items.front: Everyone admires the pictures painted by him.
items.meaning: 每個人都很欣賞他所畫的圖畫。

items.front: Finish your homework by the time they return.
items.meaning: 你要在他們回來之前把功課做完。

items.front: I got a farewell present from everyone.
items.meaning: 每個人都送了我一份歡送禮物。

items.front: Please give me a glass of milk.
items.meaning: 請給我一杯牛奶。

items.front: Red, as opposed to green, is a sign of danger.
items.meaning: 紅色，相對於綠色，是危險的標誌。

items.front: Mick killed time by reading a magazine while waiting for his date.
items.meaning: Mick等待约会的时候靠读杂志打发时间。

items.front: I felt as if I were in a dream.
items.meaning: 我感觉就像做梦一样。

items.front: She looks as if she were drunk.
items.meaning: 她看起來好像喝醉了。

items.front: Mary has a flower in her hand.
items.meaning: 瑪麗手上有一朵花。

items.front: Maria knew neither his name nor his phone number.
items.meaning: 瑪莉亞既不知道他的名字，也不知道他的電話號碼。

items.front: Maria takes piano lessons once a week.
items.meaning: 瑪麗亞每週上一次鋼琴課。

items.front: Mayuko took a bite of my apple.
items.meaning: Mayuko咬了一口我的蘋果。

items.front: Mayuko wiped a table with a cloth.
items.meaning: Mayuko用布擦桌子。

items.front: Allow me to introduce Mayuko to you.
items.meaning: 容許我向您介紹Mayuko。

items.front: For how long did the Maya culture flourish?
items.meaning: 玛雅文明繁荣了多久？

items.front: Soon the same waiter came back to pick up the dishes.
items.meaning: 不久，同样的服务员回来拿起菜。

items.front: In a few minutes we'll be landing at New Tokyo International Airport.
items.meaning: 我们将于几分钟内降落在新东京国际机场。

items.front: It was not long before we met again by chance.
items.meaning: 没多久，我们又碰巧遇到了。

items.front: It was not long before Mr Yamazaki recovered.
items.meaning: 山崎先生不久就康復了。

items.front: It soon began to rain very hard.
items.meaning: 很快就會開始大雨了。

items.front: It won't be long before we know the truth.
items.meaning: 真相很快就會水落石出了。

items.front: Mummy has to do the washing this afternoon.
items.meaning: 妈妈下午要洗衣服。

items.front: Madeira is the name of a wine.
items.meaning: 馬迪拉是酒的名字。

items.front: Quite by chance, I met my old friend at the airport.
items.meaning: 很幸运地，我在机场遇到了我的老朋友。

items.front: Mac knows how to use this computer.
items.meaning: Mac知道如何使用這台電腦。

items.front: Excuse me for opening your letter by mistake.
items.meaning: 對不起, 我錯開了你的信。

items.front: I still haven't found what I'm looking for.
items.meaning: 我還沒有找到我想要的東西。

items.front: We still have plenty of time left.
items.meaning: 我們還剩下很多時間。

items.front: I haven't made up my mind yet.
items.meaning: 我還沒有下定決心。

items.front: I hope I'll see you again soon.
items.meaning: 我希望我會很快再見到你。

items.front: It's still too early to get up.
items.meaning: 時間還早，不必這麼早起床。

items.front: I look forward to your next visit.
items.meaning: 我期待著您的再次光臨。

items.front: I am still keeping up my tennis craze.
items.meaning: 我仍然热爱着网球运动。

items.front: I haven't had a chance to see the movie yet.
items.meaning: 我還沒有機會看那部電影。

items.front: It is foolish of him to pay for it again.
items.meaning: 这是他的愚蠢付出代价了。

items.front: I look forward to seeing you again.
items.meaning: 我期待著再次見到你。

items.front: She must still be in her twenties.
items.meaning: 她一定還只是二十幾歲。

items.front: And even outside these nations, English is perhaps more widely used as a medium of international communication than any other language.
items.meaning: 甚至在這些國家以外，英語也許比其他任何語言更廣泛地被使用來當作國際交流的媒介。

items.front: To begin with, we must tackle the problem.
items.meaning: 首先我們必須處理這個問題。

items.front: The first subject that attracted my attention was philosophy.
items.meaning: 第一個吸引我注意的科目是哲學。

items.front: The first thing you have to take into consideration is time.
items.meaning: 你应该考虑的第一件事是时间。

items.front: Where would you like to go first?
items.meaning: 你想先去哪裡?

items.front: First of all, you should talk it over with your parents.
items.meaning: 你應該先和你的父母談談。

items.front: I want to eat some cake first.
items.meaning: 我想先吃點蛋糕。

items.front: Masaru wants to join the English Club.
items.meaning: 勝想加入英語俱樂部。

items.front: A friend in need is a friend indeed.
items.meaning: 患難見真情。

items.front: Believe it or not, she has three children.
items.meaning: 她有三个孩子，信不信由你。

items.front: Mother Teresa was given the Nobel prize.
items.meaning: 特蕾莎修女被授予諾貝爾獎。

items.front: Makoto found his true love on top of Ayers Rock. She's from Osaka.
items.meaning: 誠在艾爾斯岩上找到了自己真正的愛情。她來自大阪。

items.front: As a man sows, so he shall reap.
items.meaning: 种瓜得瓜，种豆得豆。

items.front: Michael, this is the restaurant where your father and I had our first date.
items.meaning: 麥可, 這家餐廳就是你爸爸和我第一次約會的地方。

items.front: Mike is the youngest in his family.
items.meaning: 邁克是他家裡最年輕的。

items.front: Mike has been making a model plane since breakfast.
items.meaning: 迈克吃完早饭以后一直在做一个模型飞机。

items.front: Mike had his teeth checked last week.
items.meaning: 麥克上週做了牙齒檢查。

items.front: Mike is the only man on the board.
items.meaning: Mike是董事会里唯一的男性。

items.front: Mike is always nagging his father to buy him a car.
items.meaning: 米克整天都在求爸爸買車給他。

items.front: Mike asked that he not be disturbed.
items.meaning: 邁克要求不要被打擾。

items.front: Mike has been out of work for a year.
items.meaning: Mike已经失业1年了。

items.front: Mike has a few friends in Florida.
items.meaning: 麥克在佛羅里達州有一些朋友。

items.front: Miss March gave me an English dictionary.
items.meaning: 三月小姐給了我一本英語詞典。

items.front: I made up my mind to get married to Margaret.
items.meaning: 我決定要和 Margaret 結婚。

items.front: Only a handful of people know the fact.
items.meaning: 知道真相的人只有幾個。

items.front: Could I see you a minute, please?
items.meaning: 讓我看你一會兒好嗎?

items.front: Do you know what it is like to be really hungry?
items.meaning: 你嘗過真正飢餓的滋味嗎？

items.front: Bob usually goes to bed at ten.
items.meaning: 鲍勃通常十点上床。

items.front: Bob has a lot of books in his room.
items.meaning: 鲍勃在他房间里有很多书。

items.front: Bob gave Tina almost all the stamps he had collected, and kept only a few for himself.
items.meaning: 鲍勃几乎把他所收集的所有邮票给了缇娜，只留了一点给他自己。

items.front: Bob has too many books to read.
items.meaning: 鲍勃有太多的书要读。

items.front: Bob worked as a clerk in the grocery store on Saturday.
items.meaning: 每周六鲍勃在杂货店做店员。

items.front: Bob forgot to bring the pass, which made him late for school.
items.meaning: 鲍勃忘记带通行证，这使得他上学迟到了。

items.front: Bob met her grandfather early in the morning.
items.meaning: 清晨，鲍勃遇见了她的祖父。

items.front: Bob entered the house through a window.
items.meaning: 鮑伯從窗戶進入了房子。

items.front: Bob missed the last train and had to take a taxi.
items.meaning: Bob錯過了最後一班火車，所以他必須搭計程車。

items.front: Bob is the only student that can speak Spanish in our class.
items.meaning: 鮑勃是我們班上唯一會講西班牙語的學生。

items.front: Bob got impatient at his wife's delay.
items.meaning: 鲍勃已无法忍受她老婆的慢性子。

items.front: Bob writes to me once a month.
items.meaning: 鮑伯每個月寫一次信給我。

items.front: Bob was somewhat chubbier than his brother.
items.meaning: 鮑勃比他兄弟稍胖點。

items.front: Bob often tries to give up smoking.
items.meaning: Bob经常试着戒烟。

items.front: Bob was washing the dishes at that time.
items.meaning: 當時包柏在洗碗。

items.front: Bob did not agree to the plan.
items.meaning: Bob不同意這個計劃。

items.front: Bob was popular with all his classmates.
items.meaning: 鮑勃很受他所有同學們的歡迎。

items.front: Bob plays not only the guitar but also the flute.
items.meaning: Bob不仅会弹吉他还会吹笛。

items.front: Bob's father teaches at a girls' school.
items.meaning: 鮑勃的父親在女校教書。

items.front: Is the hotel close to the airport?
items.meaning: 酒店离机场远不远？

items.front: It was dark when I reached the hotel.
items.meaning: 我到旅馆的时候，天已经黑了。

items.front: I'm planning to stay at the hotel.
items.meaning: 我打算待在旅館裡。

items.front: We could see the full extent of the park from the hotel.
items.meaning: 我們從酒店裏可以把整個公園看得清清楚楚。

items.front: Will you please lend me a stapler?
items.meaning: 請你借給我一支訂書機好嗎？

items.front: One of your buttons has come off.
items.meaning: 你的一個按鈕脫落了。

items.front: The boss has a good opinion of your work.
items.meaning: 老板对你的工作有很高的评价。

items.front: Boston is too cold for me, let alone Chicago.
items.meaning: 波士頓對我來說已經太冷了，更遑論是芝加哥。

items.front: Is this the right bus for Boston?
items.meaning: 這輛是去波士頓正確的巴士嗎?

items.front: I succeeded in getting what I wanted.
items.meaning: 我赢得了我想要的。

items.front: Take as many cookies as you want.
items.meaning: 想吃多少饼干就吃多少。

items.front: I don't know, nor do I care.
items.meaning: 我不知道，也不想知道。

items.front: I was laughed at in school today.
items.meaning: 我今天在学校被嘲笑了。

items.front: I will take you for a swim.
items.meaning: 我會帶你去游泳。

items.front: I don't believe you. You're always telling lies.
items.meaning: 我不相信你。你总是说谎。

items.front: I want to emphasize this point in particular.
items.meaning: 我想特别强调这一点。

items.front: I gave up smoking for a year.
items.meaning: 我戒煙一年了。

items.front: My car burns a lot of gas.
items.meaning: 我的車子很耗油。

items.front: What did you do with my glasses?
items.meaning: 你把我的眼鏡怎麼了?

items.front: My pen isn't as good as yours.
items.meaning: 我的钢笔不像你那支那么好。

items.front: What have you done with my pen? It was here a minute ago.
items.meaning: 你把我的鋼筆怎麼了? 一分鐘前它還在這裡。

items.front: He got mad at me for calling him Shorty.
items.meaning: 我把他叫做「矮子」，他就氣得不得了。

items.front: I can't afford to pay so much.
items.meaning: 我付不起這麼多錢。

items.front: Boxing is not always a rough sport.
items.meaning: 拳擊並不總是一種粗暴的運動。

items.front: Are you going to visit any other countries?
items.meaning: 你会去访问其他国家吗？

items.front: My ballpoint pen just ran out of ink.
items.meaning: 我的原珠筆沒墨了。
