items.meaning: 对我来说，Nancy是个很难相处的女孩。

items.front: Nancy was the first girl to come.
items.meaning: Nancy是最先来的女孩。

items.front: Nancy ran across an old friend of hers yesterday.
items.meaning: Nancy昨天巧遇了她的一个老朋友。

items.front: Nancy is having a chat with her friends.
items.meaning: Nancy正在和她的朋友们聊天。

items.front: Does Nancy have to do her homework now?
items.meaning: Nancy一定要现在做她的作业吗？

items.front: Does Nancy want to have a dog?
items.meaning: Nancy想不想养一条狗？

items.front: Nancy never fails to write to me once a month.
items.meaning: 南希每個月都會寫信給我，風雨不改。

items.front: Nancy never fails to arrive on time.
items.meaning: 南希從來沒有不準時到達。

items.front: Nancy is the most beautiful of the four girls.
items.meaning: 四位姑娘之中最美的是南希。

items.front: I hear that Nancy is very pretty.
items.meaning: 我聽說南西很漂亮。

items.front: He may be clever, but he is not very helpful.
items.meaning: 他很聰明，但卻不太幫得上忙。

items.front: It is true that he is young, but he is very reliable.
items.meaning: 确实，他还年轻，但是很靠得住。

items.front: In doing anything, you must do your best.
items.meaning: 做任何事，你必须要做到最好。

items.front: You were just listening to the talk, without thinking.
items.meaning: 你只是在聽講，沒有思考。

items.front: Why did you turn down his offer?
items.meaning: 你為什麼拒绝了他的提議？

items.front: What did you go to Kyoto for?
items.meaning: 你為什麼去京都?

items.front: Why do you want to be a nurse?
items.meaning: 你为什么想成为护士呢？

items.front: The reason why we cannot support his view will be given below.
items.meaning: 以下是我們不支持他的看法的理由。

items.front: Because I want to be a translator.
items.meaning: 因为我想成为翻译。

items.front: Why do so many people visit Kyoto?
items.meaning: 为什么那么多人访问京都？

items.front: Tell me why you want to go there.
items.meaning: 告诉我你为什么要去那儿。

items.front: You should not have lent the money to such a person.
items.meaning: 你不應該借錢給這樣的人。

items.front: Why do you study English every day?
items.meaning: 你為什麼每天讀英文?

items.front: I can't understand why you are so critical of him.
items.meaning: 我不明白为什么你这么批评他。

items.front: Why did you get up so early?
items.meaning: 你為什麼這麼早起？

items.front: Why are you visiting the United Kingdom?
items.meaning: 你為何走訪英國？

items.front: Science begins when you ask why and how.
items.meaning: 為何如何？你疑問的當下就是科學的開端。

items.front: There still remains much to be done.
items.meaning: 還有很多東西要做。

items.front: The late Mr Smith was a doctor.
items.meaning: 故去的斯密斯曾经是个医生。

items.front: We speak the same language, don't we?
items.meaning: 我們說的是同樣的語言，不是嗎？

items.front: That sounds like a fairly good proposal.
items.meaning: 这方案听起来不错。

items.front: It can be used as a knife.
items.meaning: 它可以被當成一把刀來用。

items.front: At one time Nigeria was a British colony.
items.meaning: 尼日利亞曾經是英國的殖民地。

items.front: I'm sure you'll love what we have on the menu tonight.
items.meaning: 我肯定你会喜欢我们今晚的菜肴。

items.front: Do you know which book sells well now?
items.meaning: 你知道现在哪本书卖得好吗？

items.front: However you do it, the result will be the same.
items.meaning: 你無論用甚麼方法，結果都是一樣。

items.front: Not knowing how to answer, I kept silent.
items.meaning: 我不知道該怎麼回答，便乾脆甚麼也不說。

items.front: I wouldn't sell that at any price.
items.meaning: 任何價格我都不會賣。

items.front: Please inform me of any changes in the situation.
items.meaning: 如果情况有任何变化，请务必通知我。

items.front: The smallest child knows such a simple thing.
items.meaning: 這麼簡單的東西三歲小孩也會。

items.front: What sort of coats are in fashion this year?
items.meaning: 今年流行甚麼款式的外套？

items.front: What kind of work will you do?
items.meaning: 你將做什麼樣的工作?

items.front: I don't want there to be any misunderstanding.
items.meaning: 我不想有任何误会。

items.front: Whatever language you study, it takes time.
items.meaning: 學習語言永遠不是一朝一夕的事。

items.front: Whatever results may follow, I will carry out my plan.
items.meaning: 無論結果會是怎樣，我也不會改變我的計劃。

items.front: He wanted to do it, whatever the consequences.
items.meaning: 不管结果如何，他想要做。

items.front: I must help her at any cost.
items.meaning: 我必须不惜一切代价帮助她。

items.front: What kind of wine do you have?
items.meaning: 您有什麼樣的葡萄酒？

items.front: Any bed is better than no bed.
items.meaning: 任何床都比沒有床好。

items.front: How did such a strange thing come about?
items.meaning: 怎么会发生这么奇怪的事？

items.front: Brush your teeth, however sleepy you are.
items.meaning: 無論你多麼想睡, 還是要刷牙。

items.front: No matter how often I tell her, she keeps making the same mistake.
items.meaning: 不管我跟她说了多少次，她还是继续犯同样的错误。

items.front: No man is so old he cannot learn.
items.meaning: 活到老，學到老。

items.front: However hard you try, you can't finish it in a week or so.
items.meaning: 你就算多努力，也不可能在一兩個星期內做完。

items.front: No matter how he tried, he could not open the door.
items.meaning: 他用盡九牛二虎之力也開不了那道門。

items.front: I will never sell my friend down the river for anything in the world.
items.meaning: 無論發生甚麼事，我也絕對不會出賣我的朋友。

items.front: Whatever game I play with you, you never win.
items.meaning: 無論我和你玩甚麼遊戲，你也總是輸。

items.front: The thief got away with the money.
items.meaning: 小偷帶著錢逃跑了。

items.front: How long can you hold your breath?
items.meaning: 你能屏住呼吸多久？

items.front: How long will we have to wait?
items.meaning: 我們要等多久？

items.front: Tracy had never used chopsticks before then.
items.meaning: 崔西在那之前從來沒有使用過筷子。

items.front: You should especially not drink on an empty stomach.
items.meaning: 你尤其不该空腹喝酒。

items.front: It is wrong to cheat at cards.
items.meaning: 玩牌作弊是錯誤的。

items.front: The invention of the transistor marked a new era.
items.meaning: 晶體管的發明標誌著一個新時代的開始。

items.front: I'd like to cash a travelers' check.
items.meaning: 我想兌換旅行支票。

items.front: The tiger cub looked like a large kitten.
items.meaning: 小老虎看起來像隻大貓。

items.front: A truck was standing in the middle of the road.
items.meaning: 路中间有一辆卡车。

items.front: Toyota Corporation announced that it would cut 1,000 positions this year.
items.meaning: 豐田公司宣佈將會在今年裁員一千人。

items.front: In any case, it's none of your business.
items.meaning: 无论如何，都不关你的事。

items.front: Tom is coming to our school tomorrow.
items.meaning: 湯姆明天會來我們的學校。

items.front: Tom gets up at six every morning.
items.meaning: 湯姆每天早上六點起床。

items.front: Tom appealed to his mother to buy a new toy for him.
items.meaning: 汤姆请求妈妈给他买新玩具。

items.front: Tom showed her the letter from Santa Claus.
items.meaning: 汤姆给她看了圣诞老人寄来的信。

items.front: Tom told her that he had written that poem two years before.
items.meaning: 汤姆告诉她那首诗是自己两年前写的。

items.front: Tom was unhappy because she wouldn't ask him anything.
items.meaning: 汤姆很不高兴，因为她从来不征求他的意见。

items.front: Tom will be scolded by his father.
items.meaning: 汤姆会被他老爸教训的。

items.front: Tom is the tallest in his class.
items.meaning: 湯姆是班上最高的。

items.front: Tom is as tall as any student in his class is.
items.meaning: 汤姆不比他班上的其他同学矮。

items.front: Tom advised him not to buy the secondhand car.
items.meaning: 汤姆劝他别买二手车。

items.front: Tom worked the clay into a vase.
items.meaning: 湯姆把黏土塑成了一個花瓶。

items.front: Tom is in bed with a fever.
items.meaning: 汤姆发烧了，正躺在床上。

items.front: Tom is a fluent speaker of Japanese.
items.meaning: 湯姆日語說得很流利。

items.front: Tom received a heavy blow on the head.
items.meaning: 汤姆的头部受了重重的一击。

items.front: Tom told us that he had a headache.
items.meaning: 汤姆告诉我们他头疼。

items.front: Tom took his girlfriend out on Saturday night.
items.meaning: 周六晚上汤姆带他女朋友出去约会了。

items.front: Tom has less money than his brother does.
items.meaning: 汤姆没他哥有钱。

items.front: Tom called to her across the street.
items.meaning: 汤姆在街的那边向她打招呼。

items.front: Tom looked at the tall man suspiciously.
items.meaning: 汤姆用怀疑的目光盯着那个高个子男人。

items.front: Tom talked too much and let the secret slip.
items.meaning: 汤姆话太多，不小心把秘密泄露了出去。

items.front: Tom stood on the platform in Westminster Underground Station.
items.meaning: 汤姆站在威斯敏斯特地铁站的站台上。

items.front: Tom is ill at ease among strangers.
items.meaning: 周围全是陌生人，这让汤姆感到很不自在。

items.front: Tom attached the string to the kite.
items.meaning: 湯姆把繩子加在了這個風箏上。

items.front: Tom is not a lazy boy. As a matter of fact, he works hard.
items.meaning: 汤姆其实并不懒，相反他很勤奋。

items.front: Tom regretted having wasted a great deal of his life.
items.meaning: 汤姆为自己浪费了大好的青春年华感到非常后悔。

items.front: Tom is head and shoulders above others.
items.meaning: 汤姆比其他人都优秀能干。

items.front: Tom expected to leave early in the morning, but he overslept.
items.meaning: 汤姆本想早上早点出发，结果却睡过头了。

items.front: Tom never used to smoke, but he does now.
items.meaning: 汤姆以前从不抽烟，不过现在开始抽了。

items.front: As Tom is honest, I like him.
items.meaning: 我喜欢汤姆，因为他很诚实。

items.front: Tom is too honest a boy to tell a lie.
items.meaning: 汤姆太老实了，连撒谎都不会。

items.front: Tom was at a loss how to express himself.
items.meaning: 湯姆不知道如何表達自己。

items.front: Tom got so absorbed in his work that he forgot to eat.
items.meaning: 汤姆太专注于他的工作，以至于忘了吃饭。

items.front: Tom is living with his uncle now.
items.meaning: 湯姆現在跟他叔叔住在一起。

items.front: Tom was badly injured in a traffic accident.
items.meaning: 湯姆在交通意外中受了重傷。

items.front: Tom came on Monday and went back the day after.
items.meaning: 汤姆星期一来的，第二天返回了。

items.front: Tom is the tallest in his family.
items.meaning: 湯姆是他家裡最高的。

items.front: Tom looked worried about the result of an English test.
items.meaning: Tom看上去对英语测试的结果很担心。

items.front: Tom, who had been working all day, wanted to have a rest.
items.meaning: 工作了一整天的汤姆想要休息一下。

items.front: Tom has no friends to play with.
items.meaning: 湯姆沒有朋友可以一起玩耍。

items.front: Tom doesn't run as fast as Bill.
items.meaning: 湯姆跑得不如比爾快。

items.front: Tom is a very good tennis player.
items.meaning: 湯姆是一個非常好的網球選手。

items.front: Tom made some mistakes in the test.
items.meaning: 湯姆在考試中犯了一些錯誤。

items.front: Tom may have missed the train. He hasn't come yet.
items.meaning: 湯姆到了現在還沒來，說不定是沒趕上火車。

items.front: It looks like Tom won the race.
items.meaning: 看起來像是湯姆贏得了比賽。

items.front: Tom will be able to swim soon.
items.meaning: 湯姆將很快就會游泳了。

items.front: Tom is on good terms with John.
items.meaning: 汤姆和约翰关系很好。

items.front: Tom is the captain of this baseball team.
items.meaning: 湯姆是這個棒球隊的隊長。

items.front: Tom was sick in bed last Sunday.
items.meaning: 湯姆上週日臥病在床。

items.front: Tom is as tall as his father.
items.meaning: 湯姆跟他爸爸一樣高。

items.front: Tom is not as old as you.
items.meaning: 湯姆的年紀不比你大。

items.front: Tom can swim as fast as you.
items.meaning: 湯姆游泳可以游得跟你一樣快。

items.front: Tom lived in Japan for ten years.
items.meaning: 湯姆住在日本十年了。

items.front: Tom is better at science than anyone else in his class.
items.meaning: 汤姆的科学成绩比班上的任何一个人都要好。

items.front: Tom's friends called him Mr Money Bags.
items.meaning: 湯姆的朋友們叫他財神爺。

items.front: Tom's hope was to win first prize.
items.meaning: 湯姆希望贏得第一名。

items.front: Tom's Japanese is improving little by little.
items.meaning: 湯姆的日語一點一點地漸漸進步中。

items.front: Tom's uncle keeps a lot of sheep.
items.meaning: 湯姆的叔叔養了很多羊。

items.front: Tom and my secret came to light.
items.meaning: 汤姆和我之间的秘密被曝光了。

items.front: Tom and I have nothing in common.
items.meaning: 我和TOM没有共同点。

items.front: Tom and Nancy broke up last month.
items.meaning: 湯姆和南西上個月分手了。

items.front: Tom and Jane got married last month.
items.meaning: Tom 和 Jane 在上個月結婚了。

items.front: Tom and Jane quarreled, but they made up the next morning.
items.meaning: 湯姆和珍吵了架，但是第二天早上就和好如初了。

items.front: I wish Tom were my younger brother.
items.meaning: 我希望湯姆是我的弟弟。

items.front: No sooner had Tom turned on the TV than the fuse blew.
items.meaning: 湯姆一打開電視，保險絲就燒了。

items.front: Tom, what would you like to have for dinner?
items.meaning: Tom, 晚餐想吃啥？

items.front: I hesitated about which road to take.
items.meaning: 我猶豫了一會，不知道走哪條路才好。

items.front: None of the teachers could solve the problem.
items.meaning: 所有的老师都无法解决这个问题。

items.front: Every student has to leave school by six.
items.meaning: 每位學生必須最晚六點放學。

items.front: Whichever way we choose will involve danger.
items.meaning: 不管我们选哪条路，都会有危险。

items.front: I haven't decided which job to apply for.
items.meaning: 我还没确定找哪份工作。

items.front: What season do you like the best?
items.meaning: 你最喜歡哪個季節？

items.front: What fruit do you like the best?
items.meaning: 你最喜欢什么水果？

items.front: How can I get to the police station?
items.meaning: 我怎么去警察局？

items.front: How did you arrive at this conclusion?
items.meaning: 你们怎么得出这个结论的？

items.front: How do you want your hair cut?
items.meaning: 你想怎麼剪你的頭髮？

items.front: I don't know which button to push.
items.meaning: 我不知道要按哪個按鈕。

items.front: How much longer will I have to stay in the hospital?
items.meaning: 我必須要在醫院再呆多長的時間呢？

items.front: In any case, I'll call you tomorrow.
items.meaning: 無論如何我明天都會打電話給你。

items.front: In any case, I must finish this work by tomorrow.
items.meaning: 無論如何我一定要在明天前完成這工作。

items.front: Tony speaks English as well as you.
items.meaning: 湯尼英語說得和你一樣好。

items.front: What a good tennis player Tony is!
items.meaning: 托尼打網球打得真好啊！

items.front: Donna was born with a silver spoon in her mouth.
items.meaning: Donna是含着金钥匙出生的。

items.front: Who do you want to speak to?
items.meaning: 你想跟誰說話？

items.front: Though very busy, she came to see me off.
items.meaning: 尽管很忙，她还是来送我了。

items.front: I'm so tired that I can't walk any longer.
items.meaning: 我累得走不動了。

items.front: I'm too tired to walk any longer.
items.meaning: 我累得走不動了。

items.front: It was so still that you would have heard a pin drop.
items.meaning: 安靜到連針掉在地上的聲音你都會聽得到。

items.front: It's too hot for us to work.
items.meaning: 太熱了所以我們無法工作。

items.front: It was so hot that I got into the shade and took a rest.
items.meaning: 因為天氣很熱，所以我就走到陰涼的地方歇了一會兒。

items.front: The weather was so cold that the lake froze over.
items.meaning: 天冷得足以让湖结冰。

items.front: It was so cold that no one wanted to go outside.
items.meaning: 天太冷了，以至于没人想去外面。

items.front: Though it was very cold, I went out.
items.meaning: 雖然天氣很冷，但我還是出去了。

items.front: The child had no overcoat on although it was very cold.
items.meaning: 雖然天氣很冷，但那小孩也沒有穿外套。

items.front: It is too dark for me to read.
items.meaning: 太暗了我無法讀。

items.front: Pretty good. Did you go to today's history seminar?
items.meaning: 非常好。你去了今天的歷史研討會嗎？

items.front: In any case, it's troublesome, isn't it?
items.meaning: 无论怎样，都很讨厌，不是吗？

items.front: We find it difficult to decide which one to buy.
items.meaning: 我们觉得很难决定买哪一个。

items.front: You may choose whichever book you like.
items.meaning: 你可以選擇任何你喜歡的書。

items.front: Which one do you think is correct?
items.meaning: 你認為哪一個是正確的?

items.front: I wonder which way is the shortest.
items.meaning: 我想知道哪一條路是最短的。

items.front: Neither team played well in the game.
items.meaning: 兩組在比賽中的表現都不太好。

items.front: You can take whichever road you like.
items.meaning: 你可以走任何你喜欢的路。

items.front: You can buy whichever you like, but not both.
items.meaning: 你喜欢哪个就买哪个,但不能两个都买。

items.front: I can't remember which is my racket.
items.meaning: 我不記得哪個是我的球拍。

items.front: By the way, are you free tonight?
items.meaning: 顺便问一句，你今晚有空吗？

items.front: By the way, have you seen him lately?
items.meaning: 顺便说一句，你最近见过他吗？

items.front: By the way, what is your address?
items.meaning: 對了，可以把你的地址告訴我嗎？

items.front: By the way, I have something to tell you.
items.meaning: 對了，我有一件事要告訴你。

items.front: By the way, have you ever been to Hokkaido?
items.meaning: 顺便问一句，你们已经去过北海道了吗？

items.front: I take my camera wherever I go.
items.meaning: 我無論去甚麼地方也帶著相機。

items.front: Information is given in English at every airport.
items.meaning: 每个机场都有英文指示。

items.front: Where did you get your hair cut?
items.meaning: 你在哪裡剪頭髮？

items.front: Where do I have to change trains?
items.meaning: 我要在哪裡換火車？

items.front: Where do I pay for the gas?
items.meaning: 我该在哪儿付煤气费？

items.front: Not knowing where to get off the bus, I asked the driver.
items.meaning: 因为我不知道应该在哪里下巴士，我问了司机。

items.front: Where did you get your camera repaired?
items.meaning: 你在哪儿修的照相机？

items.front: It's a good rule to look both ways before you cross the street anywhere.
items.meaning: 無論在甚麼地方，過馬路前也應該先看清楚左右。

items.front: Something must be wrong with the machinery.
items.meaning: 這個機器一定有什麼地方不對勁。

items.front: Will you tell me where I am wrong?
items.meaning: 你可以告訴我我錯在哪兒嗎？

items.front: Would you like to go out to have a drink somewhere?
items.meaning: 一起出去喝杯怎么样？

items.front: Tell me how you solved the problem.
items.meaning: 告訴我你如何解決了這個問題。

items.front: He seems to know all about her past.
items.meaning: 他對她的過去似乎瞭如指掌。

items.front: He seems to have been ill for a long time.
items.meaning: 他好像已經病了很久了。

items.front: How are you going to get home?
items.meaning: 你打算怎麼回家？

items.front: I can't remember how to go there.
items.meaning: 我不記得怎麼去那裡了。

items.front: I can't figure out what he means.
items.meaning: 我不懂他的意思。

items.front: In the end, because of the disease, he became unable to walk and had to use a motorized wheelchair to get around.
items.meaning: 最後，他的病奪去了他走路的能力，想去哪兒也要用電動輪椅來代步。

items.front: Would you please tell me the way?
items.meaning: 請你告訴我路怎麼走好嗎？

items.front: Please feel free to call me up.
items.meaning: 請隨時都可以打電話給我。

items.front: Please stay as long as you wish.
items.meaning: 你想待多久就待多久。

items.front: Not knowing what to do, I asked the teacher for advice.
items.meaning: 因为不知道做什么，所以我向老师寻求建议。

items.front: How did you get acquainted with her?
items.meaning: 你是怎樣認識她的？

items.front: Will you tell me why you like her?
items.meaning: 你能告诉我你为什么喜欢她吗？

items.front: How did you get to know him?
items.meaning: 你是怎么认识他的？

items.front: Why did they turn down your proposal?
items.meaning: 他們為什麼否決了你的建議呢？

items.front: Why can Taro speak English so well?
items.meaning: 為什麼太郎英語可以說得這麼好？

items.front: How did you come to know it?
items.meaning: 你是怎麼知道的？

items.front: What made you come here so early?
items.meaning: 什麼原因讓你這麼早來這裡？

items.front: Why did you come home so late?
items.meaning: 你為什麼這麼晚回家？

items.front: For some reason or other I cannot bring myself to work.
items.meaning: 不知怎麼我總是沒心情工作。

items.front: I want to get rid of it.
items.meaning: 我想擺脫它。

items.front: If you are going to smoke, please go outside.
items.meaning: 抽煙請到外面抽。

items.front: I do want to go to Italy.
items.meaning: 我真想去意大利。

items.front: Why did you paint the bench red?
items.meaning: 为什么你把长凳漆成红色了？

items.front: I can't understand why James always finds fault with his wife.
items.meaning: 我不懂得詹姆斯为什么一直给他的妻子吹毛求疵。

items.front: How come you call on us so late at night?
items.meaning: 你怎麼這麼晚才來看我們？

items.front: I wonder why karaoke is so popular.
items.meaning: 我不知道為什麼卡拉OK如此受歡迎。

items.front: Not knowing what to do, he asked me for help.
items.meaning: 他不知道該怎麼做，於是便找我幫忙。

items.front: Why can't you take things just as they are?
items.meaning: 你為甚麼不隨遇而安呢？

items.front: Why do they say you have to learn English to survive?
items.meaning: 怎麼會有人認為不懂英語就不能生存？

items.front: Please tell me how I can get in touch with him.
items.meaning: 請告訴我怎樣才能聯絡上他。

items.front: Please let me know the result by telephone.
items.meaning: 請你打電話把結果告訴我。

items.front: I hope you will be quite well again before long.
items.meaning: 我希望不久以后你又能好起来。

items.front: Bring me a sheet of paper, please.
items.meaning: 请带一张纸给我。

items.front: Please give me a piece of bread.
items.meaning: 請你給我一塊麵包。

items.front: Would you please turn down the TV?
items.meaning: 你可以把電視的音量調低一點嗎？

items.front: Please send me a picture of yourself.
items.meaning: 请寄给我一张你的照片。

items.front: I leave it in your hands what course of action to take.
items.meaning: 接下来该采取什么行动就交给你了。

items.front: What kind of people do you like best?
items.meaning: 你最喜歡哪一種人?

items.front: I can't remember how to say "Thank you" in German.
items.meaning: 我想不起「謝謝」用德語怎麼說。

items.front: Germany adopted a social security system in the 1880's.
items.meaning: 德国在1880年代采取了一种社会保障制度。

items.front: Germany was allied with Italy in World War II.
items.meaning: 在二战中，德国与意大利结盟。

items.front: In Germany today, anti-violence rallies took place in several cities, including one near Hamburg where three Turks were killed in an arson attack on Monday.
items.meaning: 今日在德国，反暴力集会着落到了德国的很多城市，包括周一在汉堡附近一场纵火袭击中3名突厥人被杀害的地方。

items.front: In opening the door, I broke the lock.
items.meaning: 我开门的时候弄坏了锁。

items.front: When I opened the door, I found him asleep.
items.meaning: 当我打开门的时候，我发现他睡着了。

items.front: I tried to open the door, and the doorknob came off.
items.meaning: 我開門的時候把門柄扭了出來。

items.front: Open the door and let me in, please.
items.meaning: 拜託你開門讓我進來吧。

items.front: Would you mind my opening the door?
items.meaning: 你介意我開門嗎?

items.front: I knocked on the door, but nobody answered.
items.meaning: 我敲门，但是没有人回应。

items.front: Would you please not leave the door open?
items.meaning: 你可以不把門開著嗎？

items.front: The door is locked at nine o'clock.
items.meaning: 這個門在九點鐘的時候是鎖著的。。

items.front: We couldn't open the door because it was locked from within.
items.meaning: 我們無法打開這扇門，因為它從裡面被反鎖了。

items.front: The handle came away from the door when I grasped it.
items.meaning: 我握住門把，它就從門上掉了下來。

items.front: The bicycle by the door is mine.
items.meaning: 在門口的自行車是我的。

items.front: It was careless of you to leave the door unlocked.
items.meaning: 你沒鎖好門，真不小心呢。

items.front: The door was suddenly opened by Mike.
items.meaning: 門突然被 Mike 門啟了。

items.front: As soon as the door opened, they ran away.
items.meaning: 门一开，他们就逃走了。

items.front: It took us half an hour to set up the tent.
items.meaning: 搭帳篷花了我們半小時。

items.front: It cost me ten thousand yen to have my television set repaired.
items.meaning: 把我的電視機修好花了我一萬日元。

items.front: I'll do my homework after I watch television.
items.meaning: 我看完電視才去做功課。

items.front: Television has the advantage of providing sports fans with greater convenience.
items.meaning: 电视的优点在于它给体育爱好者提供了更大的方便。

items.front: The fact that television frequently limits communication within families is already well known.
items.meaning: 电视限制家庭成员的沟通的事实已经广为人知。

items.front: Some people say that cartoons on television are educational in themselves.
items.meaning: 有人說電視上的卡通本身是有教育意義的。

items.front: The invention of TV caused a drastic change in our daily life.
items.meaning: 電視的發明為我們的生活模式帶來了巨大的變化。

items.front: According to TV news, there was a plane crash in India.
items.meaning: 根据电视新闻，一架飞机在印度坠毁了。

items.front: Thanks to television, boys and girls are apt to neglect reading books.
items.meaning: 拜電視所賜，現在的小孩都不喜歡看書了。

items.front: It is a pleasure to watch a baseball game on TV.
items.meaning: 在電視上看棒球比賽是一件樂事。

items.front: I have seen him on TV but not in the flesh.
items.meaning: 我在电视上看到过他，不过没有看到过他本人。

items.front: You can't say four-letter words on TV.
items.meaning: 你不能在電視上罵粗口。

items.front: My television was broken down, so I had to get it repaired.
items.meaning: 我的电视机出故障了，所以我不得不拿去修。

items.front: I would like to see Mr Terry Tate.
items.meaning: 我想要见见Terry Tate先生。

items.front: But I am able to cook well.
items.meaning: 但我有能力烧得好菜。

items.front: David has so many girlfriends that he can't remember all of their names.
items.meaning: 大衛有如此多的女朋友，以至於他無法記得他們所有的人的名字。

items.front: I will ask him about it tomorrow, then.
items.meaning: 那我明天会问他的。

items.front: I am afraid I must be going now.
items.meaning: 不好意思，我要走了。

items.front: Playing tennis is a lot of fun.
items.meaning: 打網球很有趣。

items.front: I play tennis an hour a day.
items.meaning: 我每天打一小时网球。

items.front: Ted waited for her for a long time.
items.meaning: Ted 等了她很久。

items.front: Ted was finally able to communicate his thoughts in Japanese.
items.meaning: Ted最终能用日语交流他的想法了。

items.front: If Ted were here, he could help us clean our room.
items.meaning: 如果Ted在这儿，他就能帮我们打扫房间了。

items.front: I'd like to have cake for dessert.
items.meaning: 我想吃蛋糕當點心。

items.front: I would like to go home now.
items.meaning: 我現在想回家了。

items.front: I will help you as far as I can.
items.meaning: 我会尽可能帮你的。

items.front: Refer to the dictionary as often as possible.
items.meaning: 儘可能多點查字典。

items.front: Let's go and see as many things as we can.
items.meaning: 我们走，尽可能多看点东西。

items.front: I will get in touch with him as soon as possible.
items.meaning: 我會儘快和他聯絡。

items.front: Get it done as soon as possible.
items.meaning: 盡快把它完成。

items.front: Please come home as quickly as possible.
items.meaning: 請你盡快回家。

items.front: I'll finish it as quickly as I can.
items.meaning: 我会尽快完成的。

items.front: I spend what time I can spare reading.
items.meaning: 我把空閒時間全都花在閱讀上。

items.front: Enjoy your life while you are able to.
items.meaning: 能夠的時候就好好享受人生吧。

items.front: Do this work by tomorrow if possible.
items.meaning: 如果可能的话，在明天前做好这个工作。

items.front: I want a map of Texas on a scale of 1 to 250000.
items.meaning: 我想要一张1比250000的得克萨斯州的地图。

items.front: The calculator on the table is mine.
items.meaning: 桌上的计算器是我的。

items.front: There is a book on the table.
items.meaning: 桌子上有本书。

items.front: Is there a cat on the table?
items.meaning: 桌子上有只猫吗？

items.front: There is an apple on the table.
items.meaning: 桌上有个苹果。

items.front: There was a broken cup on the table.
items.meaning: 桌上有個破杯子。

items.front: Don't put your elbows on the table.
items.meaning: 不要把你的手肘放在桌子上。

items.front: She put the magazine on the table.
items.meaning: 她把雜誌放在桌上。

items.front: As is evident from the data, smoking is not decreasing among the young.
items.meaning: 数据表明年轻人抽烟的现象没有减少。

items.front: Do you often have fish for dinner?
items.meaning: 你常常晚餐吃魚嗎？

items.front: Dick talks as if he knew everything.
items.meaning: 迪克講起話來好像他什麼都知道。

items.front: Dick played the piano and Lucy sang.
items.meaning: 迪克彈鋼琴露西唱歌。

items.front: That is, she is a poor dancer.
items.meaning: 那是, 她是個貧窮的舞者。

items.front: In short, it is because the 'plan.doc' file I attached in the previous email was infected with a virus.
items.meaning: 簡單來說，就是因為我附在上一封電郵的「plan.doc」檔案被電腦病毒感染了。

items.front: It shows that English is no longer the language only of the people of England.
items.meaning: 由此可見，英文已經不再是專屬英國人的語言了。

items.front: I attended the party just to be sociable.
items.meaning: 我去那個派對純粹是為了交際。

items.front: Finally, the discord between them came to an end.
items.meaning: 他們的衝突終於平息了。

items.front: Finally she gave in to temptation and ate the whole cake.
items.meaning: 她終於受不了誘惑，吃掉了整件蛋糕。

items.front: At last, they experienced the joy of victory.
items.meaning: 最后，他们感受到了胜利的喜悦。

items.front: At last, they reached the top of the mountain.
items.meaning: 他們終於到達了山頂。

items.front: At last, John and Sue decided to cut the apple into halves.
items.meaning: 約翰和蘇最後決定把蘋果切成兩半。

items.front: I often feel like just going over there.
items.meaning: 我经常想去那里。

items.front: I've got a touch of the flu.
items.meaning: 我有點流感。

items.front: Hold on a second, I'll be right back. Don't hang up!
items.meaning: 等一下，我马上就回来。不要挂断电话！

items.front: Hang on a minute. I'll call Jimmy.
items.meaning: 等一下。我去叫吉米。

items.front: I don't eat supper because I want to lose some weight.
items.meaning: 我不吃晚饭因为我想减肥。

items.front: Will you excuse me for just a moment?
items.meaning: 不好意思，我失陪一下。

items.front: Wouldn't you like to get some fresh air?
items.meaning: 想出去呼吸一下新鮮空氣嗎？

items.front: A little walk will give you a good appetite for breakfast.
items.meaning: 散散步將會給你很好的食慾吃早餐。

items.front: Let's take a rest for a while.
items.meaning: 我们休息一会儿吧。

items.front: A couple of flights were delayed on account of a minor accident.
items.meaning: 因為一些小事故，兩、三班機被延遲了。

items.front: A little bit of luck sometimes leads to an unexpected success.
items.meaning: 一點點的運氣有時會導致意想不到的成功。

items.front: I get depressed by the slightest things.
items.meaning: 我為小事情覺得沮喪。

items.front: Could you move the chair a bit?
items.meaning: 你可以移一移那張椅子嗎？

items.front: Please bring me two pieces of chalk.
items.meaning: 给我拿两根粉笔来，谢谢。

items.front: It is not easy to write in chalk.
items.meaning: 用粉笔写字不容易。

items.front: I'd just woken up and was still drowsy.
items.meaning: 我那時剛剛起床，還迷迷糊糊的。

items.front: Just as he was speaking, a fire broke out.
items.meaning: 當他說話的時候，發生了火災。

items.front: Just as food feeds the body, so reading feeds the mind.
items.meaning: 就像食物餵養身體，所以閱讀餵養心靈。

items.front: I've got my friend on the line right now.
items.meaning: 我正在和朋友打电话呢。

items.front: This is the very book you wanted.
items.meaning: 這是你非常想要的書。

items.front: I've just been to my uncle's house.
items.meaning: 我剛剛去了我叔叔家。

items.front: Charles Lindbergh made the first solo flight across the Atlantic Ocean in 1927.
items.meaning: Charles Lindbergh於1927年成功完成了第一次獨自飛越大西洋。

items.front: In addition to being a great statesman, Churchill was a great writer.
items.meaning: 邱吉爾不僅是一位偉大的政治家，還是一位偉大的作家。

items.front: I am not the least bit worried.
items.meaning: 我一點也不擔心。

items.front: To purchase a ticket, you need to enter your personal details.
items.meaning: 你要先輸入好個人資料，然後才能買票。

items.front: Can I leave my bags with you until I come to check in?
items.meaning: 我來登記之前你可以先幫我看管行李嗎？

items.front: I will teach you to play chess.
items.meaning: 我會教你下棋。

items.front: Don't you know cheese is made from milk?
items.meaning: 你不知道乳酪是用牛奶做的嗎？

items.front: The days are getting longer and longer.
items.meaning: 白天漸漸地越來越長。

items.front: My mother will attend to the baby while I go to the dance.
items.meaning: 我去參加舞會，母親就幫忙照顧嬰兒。

items.front: Why don't you come dancing with me?
items.meaning: 为什么你不来跟我跳舞？

items.front: I love you more than anyone else.
items.meaning: 我爱你胜过其他任何一个人。

items.front: She assumed that everyone would be for the plan.
items.meaning: 她以為所有人都會贊成計劃。

items.front: If you have a bone to pick with a person, tell it to his face instead of saying things behind his back.
items.meaning: 如果你们之间有问题，应该当面告诉他，不要在背后说他。

items.front: When you shake hands with somebody, you must look him in the eye.
items.meaning: 和別人握手的時候，一定要有眼神接觸。

items.front: If there is somebody to back me up, the business will be successful.
items.meaning: 如果有人支持的話，生意是會成功的。

items.front: Sometimes it's good for a married couple to go to a hot spring together—just the two of them.
items.meaning: 兩夫婦應該閒時去浸溫泉，過過二人世界。

items.front: It's okay to take it easy sometimes.
items.meaning: 有時可以放輕鬆一下。

items.front: It so happened that they were not there.
items.meaning: 他們剛好不在那裏。

items.front: It happened that I met Mr Uno on the street.
items.meaning: 我碰巧在街上遇到了Uno先生。

items.front: It happened that we were in London.
items.meaning: 那時我們剛好就在倫敦。

items.front: Maybe he will be a good teacher.
items.meaning: 也許他會是一個很好的老師。

items.front: I guess that would be all right.
items.meaning: 我猜那應該可以的。

items.front: Perhaps it will rain in the afternoon.
items.meaning: 也許下午會下雨。

items.front: You do such a thing once too often and get punished.
items.meaning: 你一錯再錯，當然會被處罰。

items.front: Smoking is not good for the health.
items.meaning: 吸烟对身体有害。

items.front: I will go even if it rains tomorrow.
items.meaning: 就算明天下雨，我也會去的。

items.front: Even if he is busy, he will come.
items.meaning: 他就算多忙也會來的。

items.front: No matter how cold it is outside, the rooms are comfortably heated.
items.meaning: 無論外面多麼寒冷，房間始終既舒適又溫暖。

items.front: No matter what happens, I am prepared.
items.meaning: 不管發生什麼事，我都準備好了。

items.front: I will go there even if it rains.
items.meaning: 即使下雨我也會去那裡。

items.front: Even if it rains, the game will be played.
items.meaning: 就算下雨，比赛也将照常进行。

items.front: The soccer game will be played, even if it rains.
items.meaning: 就算下雨，足球比賽也會如期進行。

items.front: Even if it rains, I'll go swimming tomorrow.
items.meaning: 明天就算下雨，我也會去游泳。

items.front: Such poets as Toson and Hakushu are rare.
items.meaning: 藤村和白秋这样的诗人太少了。

items.front: However hard you may study, you can't master English in a year or so.
items.meaning: 無論你多麼努力，也不可能只花一年左右就精通英文。

items.front: Even if it is true, it matters little.
items.meaning: 就算是真的，也沒有多大的關係。

items.front: Even if you do not like it, you must take charge of it.
items.meaning: 就算你不喜歡，你也要負責管理。

items.front: You must do it even if you don't want to.
items.meaning: 你就算不想做，也一定要做。

items.front: Tatsuya has some friends who live in New York.
items.meaning: 達也有一些朋友住在紐約。

items.front: An ostrich does not fly through the air.
items.meaning: 駝鳥不會在空中飛。

items.front: We must carry out the plan at once.
items.meaning: 我們必須馬上實行這個計畫。

items.front: I just wish we could leave this horrible place.
items.meaning: 我只是希望我们能离开这个可怕的地方。

items.front: Could you please get me a taxi?
items.meaning: 你可以幫我叫一輛計程車嗎?

items.front: I left my umbrella in the cab.
items.meaning: 我把我的傘忘在計程車上了。

items.front: You ought to go by taxi, or you might not get there in time.
items.meaning: 你最好乘出租車去，不然可能會趕不及。

items.front: I've had enough, so my stomach is full.
items.meaning: 我吃飽了，所以我的胃都滿了。

items.front: Many stars are twinkling in the sky.
items.meaning: 一顆一顆的星星在空中閃閃發光。

items.front: A good many people have told me to take a holiday.
items.meaning: 很多人都跟我說要我休假。

items.front: A lot of young people went to Hawaii this summer.
items.meaning: 今年夏天滿多情人去夏威夷旅行。

items.front: A lot of houses were washed away by the flood.
items.meaning: 许多房屋被洪水冲走了。

items.front: That's why I told you not to go by car.
items.meaning: 這就是我叫你別乘車去的原因。

items.front: Where is the bus stop for downtown?
items.meaning: 到市區的公車站牌在哪裡？

items.front: I had to push my bicycle because I had a flat tire.
items.meaning: 我得推我的自行车，因为有个轮胎漏气了。

items.front: Imagine that you have a time machine.
items.meaning: 如果你有一台時光機⋯⋯

items.front: In Thailand, bringing up the children isn't the father's responsibility; it's entirely up to the mother.
items.meaning: 在泰國，照顧子女不是父親的責任，而是由母親一手包辦的。

items.front: I usually ride my bike to school. I mean to the office.
items.meaning: 我通常踏單車上學⋯⋯啊，說錯了，應該是上班才對。

items.front: On the whole I am satisfied with the result.
items.meaning: 总的来说，我对这个结果很满意。

items.front: The Tigers lost the game, which was a surprise to us.
items.meaning: 我們覺得很驚訝老虎隊竟然輸掉了比賽。

items.front: Da Vinci could see farther than others.
items.meaning: 达芬奇比别人高瞻远瞩。

items.front: It is dangerous to drive so fast.
